tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rje btsun mar lugs kyi gsang ba 'dus pa'i cho ga 'phags pa'i zhal lung khrigs chags bklag pas grub par bkod pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ gsang 'dus klu sgrub blo gtsug zla ba'i shel// sher bzangs kyis lon brgyud mar mchog mi la// ster bas mtshur sogs dga' byed rgyal bu dang*// de lugs gar 'char me long kun la'ang 'dud// mdor byas mdo dang bsre ba rnam gzhag rim// rdo rje sems dpa' sgrub thabs ji lta ba'i// cho ga'i dri bsung phul du byung ba zhig /pad dkar sdong bu'i ngag las gsar du 'ongs// rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed pa ni rim pa'i mdo dang bsre bar/ de la thog ma gnas nges pa dang*/ snying rje chen po la dmigs pa dang*/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang*/ stong pa nyid la dmigs pa dang*/ sa'i cha bskyed pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang dang*/ dkyil 'khor dgod pa dang*/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa dang*/ ldang ba dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs pa dang*/ mthar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ rdo rje 'chang chen po bskyed pa dang*/ sngags kyis byin gyi brlabs pas phung po la sogs pa dgod pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ ldan pa'i 'dus byas dang*/ rdo rje pad+ma 'dus byas pa dang*/ rjes su chags pa'i rdo rje byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor phyung ba dang*/ phra mo'i sbyor ba dang*/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ don dam pa la zhugs pa dang*/ rab tu skul bas blang ba dang*/ bstod pa byed pa dang*/ nye bar bsdu ba dang*/ las kyi rab tu dbye ba rnams su shes par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i dang po ni/ dgon pa chen po la sogs pa yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas shar du mngon par phyogs pas sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis mnyam par gnas te/ rang gi snying gar pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs pa la/ khams gsum spyod pa las grol mkha' dang mnyam gyur dngos po'i ngo bo nyid// dag cing zhi la rnam dben mchog gi rnal 'byor pa nyid yul// rtogs dka' brtag par dka' la bdag gzhan rab phan khyab cing mtshan ma med// rgyal ba'i bde ba mnyam med mnyam sku mi rtog yul gcig la phyag 'tshal//

zhes phyag 'tshal/ snying ga nas 'phros pa'i gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wid+ya= shap+ta= zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ shap+ta= gan+dhe= ra sa= spar+she= zhes mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/ ces bdun rnam dag bya/ gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po'i sems kyis/ 'chad par 'gyur ba bzhin gyis/ bdag dang gzhan la phan pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang bsgrub par bya'o// snyam du sems bskyed pa'o// gsum pa ni/ de nas bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na khro bo'i rdo rje rtse dgu/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ ral pa'i thor tsugs la rin po che'i prog zhu dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ rang 'dra ba'i yum reg bya rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gi bzhugs par gyur/ badz+ra dhṛka mdun du skad cig gis mi bskyod pa sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na khro bo'i rdo rje rtse dgu/

'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ ral pa'i thor tsugs la rin po che'i prog zhu dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ rang 'dra ba'i yum reg bya rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ de bdag nyid kyi lus la chu dang 'o ma'i tshul du rjes su zhugs pas bdag nyid in+d+ra nī la'i mdog can zhe sdang rdo rje mthing dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum gyi dbus ma khros pa g.yas pa zhi zhing g.yon pa chags pa'i nyams can phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na khro bo'i rdo rje rtse dgu/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ ral pa'i thor tsugs la rin po che'i prog zhu dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ rang 'dra ba'i yum reg bya rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ thugs ka nas shar du gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdig mdzub/ dril bu/ dgra s+t+wa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ mer mi g.yo ba mthing nag mthing dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na ral gri/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdig mdzub/ dgra s+t+wa/ zhags pa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ dbyug pa/ ral gri/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ dril bu/ dgra s+t+wa/

rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa/ bden bral du 'dod pa'i rgyal po mthing nag mthing dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje/ ral gri/ g.yon gnyis zhags pa/ lcags kyu/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na pad+ma/ ral gri/ gtun shing*/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ dgra s+t+wa/ zhags pa/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan pa/ rlung du dbyug pa sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ pad+ma/ dgra s+t+wa/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ gtun shing*/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ dril bu/ dgra s+t+wa/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ dbang ldan du stobs po che nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ rtse gsum/ dgra s+t+wa/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gtsug tor spyi bo 'dzin pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis sdigs mdzub/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin chen/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan can/ de thams cad kyang shin tu khros pa'i zhal gdangs shing drag po'i gad rgyang can/

mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan dmar po gsum gzir zhing sma ra ag tshoms mer 'bar ba/ sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ yan lag rags pa/ dpal gyi chas kyis brgyan te/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas phyogs skyong brdzis te me'i phung po'i nang du kha phyir bstan te bzhugs pa/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ gṛh+na gṛh+na huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ gṛh+na pa ya gṛh+na pa ya huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wāṃ bid+yā rā dza huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces gnod mdzes la bka' bsgos pas de las sprul pa'i gnod mdzes gnyis pa 'ongs te des bgegs dang log 'dren rnams lcags kyus bkug zhags pas bcings/ lcags sgrogs gis bsdams/ dril bus mnyes te phyogs bcur khro bo so so la gtad/ de dag gis gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i khar/ khro bo bgegs mthar byed kyis rang 'dra ba'i sprul pa byang du bzhag nas rang nyid stod khro bo smad rtse mo gcig pa'i rdo rje phur bu'i rnam par snang bas bgegs rnams kyi mgo bor gnas pa la/ oṃ gha gha/ gha ta ya gha ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭān phaṭ phaṭ/ kī li kī li ya/ sarba pā pān phaṭ phaṭ/ hūṃ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya/ badz+ra dha rā ādz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba bighā naṃ kā ya wa ka tsit+taṃ kī la ya hūṃ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra/ badz+ra kī li ya/ ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya/ zhes gnod mdzes kyi rdo rje lcags kyu tho ba me rab tu 'bar bar gyur nas phur bu rnams la bsdigs pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas gsang ba'i bar phug ste/ gser gyi sa gzhi la sbrags nas g.yo 'gul med cing bde ba chen po'i ror gyur/ de rnams las ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga rab tu 'bar bas gdug pa can thams cad bsregs par gyur/ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥlcags dang chu dang me dang rlung rnams kyi ra ba bzhis phyi rol rim pa bzhin bskor ba/ hūm̐ ka ra/ steng du rdo rje'i gur mchod rten lta bur lcags kyi rwa ba'i steng du gnas pa/

hūm̐ sa'i cha rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rang dang khro bo thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ/ mgrin par pad+ma la ā/ snying khar nyi ma la hūm̐ gi go cha'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ dngos po med la sgom pa med// bsgom par bya ba bsgom pa min// de ltar dngos po dngos med pas// bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o// zhes brjod pas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang khams gsum yang de bzhin nyid du bzhugs pa gyur/ de ni don dam pa'i bsrung ba'o// lnga pa ni/ de nas nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i rnam pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du paṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ thams cad kyi steng 'og hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de thams cad gcig tu gyur pa las rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ drug pa ni/ de'i dbus su bh+rūṃ las dpag tshad brgya'i tshad tsam gyi rin po che'i rang bzhin gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhin thig bzhi dang ldan pa/ ka ba brgyad kyis mdzes pa/ lha dang mi'i las khyad par du 'phags pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bzhugs pa'i mchod rten/ mdzes pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas su zla ba nyi ma'i gdan 'khod pa/ bdun pa ni/ de'i dbus su bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang reg bya rdo rje ma dang snyoms par 'jug pas pad nyi'i gdan la sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ de dang dus mnyam par shar du rnam snang*/ lhor rin 'byung*/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don grub/ mer spyan ma/ bden bral du mā ma kī/ rlung du gos dkar/ dbang ldan du sgrol ma/ rim pa gnyis pa'i me nas brtsams pa'i mtshams su gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ sgra rdo rje ma dang*/ dri rdo rje ma dang*/

ro rdo rje ma dang*/ rim pa gsum pa'i snam bur shar nas g.yas bskor gyis/ byams pa/ sa snying*/ phyag rdor/ nam snying*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs/ sgrib sel/ kun bzang*/ shar sgor gshin rje gshed/ lhor sgor shes rab mthar byed/ nub sgor pad+ma mthar byed/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can byang shar du stobs po che/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ zhes lhag par mos pa'o// bsnyen pa'o// brgyad pa ni/ rang gi lus kyi phung po la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sangs rgyas lnga dang*/ khams la rig pa'i lha mo rnams dang*/ skye mched la sems dpa' sems ma dang*/ yan lag la khro bo rnams bzhugs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdul phra rab las grub par gyur/ zhes bdag nyid kyi lus dkyil kyi dkyil 'khor mos par bya'o// de nas sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha/ rnam snang*/ spyan ma/ gzugs rdo rje ma/ byams pa/ sa snying*/ gshin rje/ mi g.yo ba rnams 'od gsal du thim/ de nas rin 'byung*/ mā ma kī/ sgra rdo rje ma/ phyag rdor/ shes rab mthar byed/ 'dod rgyal rnams thim/ de nas 'od dpag med/ gos dkar/ dri rdo rje ma/ nam snying*/ pad+ma mthar byed/ dbyug sngon can rnams thim/ de nas don grub/ sgrol ma/ ro rdo rje ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sgrib sel/ kun bzang*/ bgegs mthar byed/ stobs po che rnams thim/ de nas reg bya rdo rje/ gtsug tor/ gnod mdzes gsum 'jam dpal la/ de nas gtso bo/ de thams cad stong pa'i 'od gsal la don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas chos skur brtan par bya'o// stong pa'i byang chub bo/ dgu pa ni/ stong pa nyid dmigs pas nyon mongs pa'i dri ma bsal nas/

bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' phyag rgya chen po'i gzugs su ldang ba'i phyir/ bcu pa ni/ don dam pa'i bden pa de las nam mkha'i dbyings su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum steng bar 'og gis gnas pa/ bcu gcig pa ni/ de thams cad gcig tu gyur pa las zla ba nya gang ba sems tsam gyi ngo bo// de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis phyi snod nang bcud kyi 'jig rten thams cad bsdus nas de nyid la thim/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes sems rin po che brtan par bya'o// de ni rnal 'byor ram sbyor ba'o// bcu gnyis pa ni/ zla ba nya gang ba de'i steng oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa las/ sa bon bsdu ba'o/ /bdag nyid dang po'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang chen po longs spyod rdzogs par skad cig gi gyur pa ni rjes su rnal 'byor ram rjes su sbyor ba'o/

/de nas srid pa tha mal pa'i sems can gyi don gyi phyir mdun du mi bskyod pa sprul/ de bdag nyid la rjes su zhugs pas rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum rdo rje/ 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin po che/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ nye bar sgrub pa gzugs rdzogs pa'o// bcu gsum pa ni/ de'i spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin oṃ dkar po gzugs kyi phung po/ mgrin par 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin āḥdamar po 'du shes kyi phung po/ snying gar mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin hūm̐ sngon po rnam shes kyi phung po/ lte bar rin 'byung gi rang bzhin swa ser po tshor ba'i phung po/ rkang pa gnyis la don grub kyi rang bzhin hā ljang khu 'du byed kyi phung po/ mo hā ra ti spyan ma sa'i khams la/ dwe ṣa ra ti mā ma kī chu'i khams la/ rā ga ra ti gos dkar mo me'i khams la/ badz+ra ra ti sgrol ma rlung gi khams la/ thiṃl sa snying mig gi skye mched la/ oṃ phyag rdor rna ba'i skye mched la/ oṃ nam snying rna ba'i skye mched la/ oṃ 'jig rten dbang phyug lce'i skye mched la/ hūm̐ 'jam dpal yid kyi skye mched la/ oṃ sgrib sel lus kyi skye mched la/ maiṃ byams pa rtsa rgyus la/ saṃ kun tu bzang po tshigs thams cad la/ hūm̐ gshin rje mthar byed lag pa g.yas/ hūm̐ shes rab mthar byed g.yon par/ hūm̐ pad+ma mthar byed khar/ hūm̐ bgegs mthar byed gsang ba'i rdo rjer/ hūm̐ mi g.yo ba dpung pa g.yas/ hūm̐ 'dod rgyal g.yon par/ hūm̐ dbyug sngon can pus mo g.yas/ hūm̐ stobs po che g.yon/ hūm̐ gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba spyi bor/ hūm̐ gnod mdzes rgyal po rkang gnyis la/ thams cad de dag tu ye shes kyi rang bzhin du rjes su zhugs pas sprul pa'i skur gyur pa ni shin tu rnal 'byor ram shin tu sbyor ba'o// bcu bzhi pa/

de nas spyi bo'i dbus su zla ba oṃ dkar po 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba las byung ba'i spyan ma rnam par snang mdzad dang sbyor ba nam mkha' gang ba'i dbus kyi gtso bo'i mdun du bdag nyid gnas nas/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// rdo rje'i sku ni mdzad du gsol// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// rdo rje skur ni mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas lha'i tshogs de thams cad rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro bas mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong nas 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par zhu ba bdag gi rnam snang gi sgo nas zhugs te lus thams cad gang bas skus byin gyis brlabs/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang yin// phung po lnga yis rab gang bas// sangs rgyas sku yi ngo bo yi// bdag kyang de dang 'dra bar shog oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po 'od zer lnga rab tu 'phro ba las byung ba'i gos dkar mo 'od dpag med dang sbyor ba nam mkha' gang ba'i dbus kyi gtso bo'i mdun du bdag nyid 'dug nas/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal dang ldan/ rdo rjer= deng bdag= rdo'i gsung du= phyogs= rdo rje= deng bdag= rdo rje'i gsung du= zhes gsol ba btab pas lha'i tshogs de dag thams cad rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong nas 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par zhu ba bdag gi zhal nas zhugs te lus thams cad gang bas gsung gi byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang yin// nges pa'i tshig ni phun sums tshogs// bdag gi tshig kyang de 'dra zhing*// chos 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāk+ka badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer lnga rab tu 'phro ba las byung ba'i mā ma kī mi bskyod pa dang sbyor ba/ nam mkha' gang ba'i dbus kyi gtso bo'i mdun du bdag nyid 'dug nas/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'chang ba/ rdo rje mi phyed= deng bdag= rdo rje'i thugs su= phyogs bcur= rdo rje mi phyed= deng bdag= rdo rje'i thugs su mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas lha'i tshogs de dag thams cad rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong nas 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par bdag gi thugs kar zhugs te lus thams cad gang bas thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs// kun tu bzang po'i thugs gang yin// gsang ba'i bdag po'i blo ldan pa// bdag kyang de dang 'dra gyur te// rdo rje 'dzin dang mtshungs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas rdo rje gsum mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bco lnga pa ni/ de ltar dam tshig sems dpa' bsgoms nas de'i snying gar ye shes sems dpa' longs sku'i bdag nyid dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril bzung nas rang snang gi shes rab ma dang kha sbyor gyi sbyor bas lus thams cad tshim par byed pa dang spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang ye shes sems dpa'i snying gar yi ge hūm̐ mi shes pa'i mun pa 'joms pa'i snang ba'i phung po can bsgom mo// rnal 'byor chen po'am sbyor ba chen po'o// de yan ting nge 'dzin rgyal mchog go /sgrub pa/ bcu drug pa ni/ phyi'i rang rigs kyi phyag rgya'am med na/ snying ga nas phyung ba'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya reg bya rdo rje mar gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar swā/ rkang par hā/ rigs lnga/

'byung ba bzhi yum bzhi/ skye mched sems ma lnga/ lag pa g.yas par ro langs ma/ g.yon par gzhan gyi mi thub ma/ kha la khro gnyer can ma/ bha gar ral gcig ma/ dpung pa g.yas par de bzhin gshegs yum rdo rje ma/ g.yon par sna tshogs rin chen/ dpung pa g.yas par sna tshogs pad+ma/ g.yon la sna tshogs las ma/ spyi bor nam mkha'i rdo rje ma/ rkang mthil gnyis la sa 'dzin lha mo/ bcu bdun pa ni/ rang gi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po dbus ma oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lha mo'i bha ga āḥlas pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po 'od zer lnga yis khyab pa/ bco brgyad pa ni/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa phan tshun rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro bas 'khyud pa dang 'o bya ba gzhib pas yi ge hūm̐ glur len cing las la gnas par byas te 'byin pa'i skabs su phaṭḥ ces brjod/ lha rnams mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bas rtsa'i bu ga nas thig le'i gzugs kyis pad+ma'i dbus su babs par gyur// don yod grub pa'i nga rgyal gyis des phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad mchod de oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de dag ni dang po'i sbyor ba'o// gnyis su med pa'i nga rgyal gzung ngo*// dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ shes rab kyi pad+mar byang chub sems de cha so gnyis kyi sngags su gyur pa'i dang po/ badz+ra dhṛk mi bskyod pa sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na khro bo'i rdo rje rtse dgu/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ ral pa'i thor tsugs la rin po che'i prog zhu dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/

rang 'dra ba'i yum reg bya rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad/ khyad par sems can rnams kyi zhe sdang gi nyon mongs pa sbyangs te slar byon/ mdun du 'dug ste de bdag nyid kyi lus la chu la 'o ma'i tshul du rjes su zhugs pas bdag nyid in+d+ra ni la'i mdog can/ zhe sdang rdo rje mthing dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum gyi dbus ma khros pa/ g.yas pa zhi zhing g.yon pa chags pa'i nyams can/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum du khro bo'i rdo rje rtse dgu/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ ral pa'i thor tsugs la rin po che'i prog zhu dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum reg bya rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dzi na dz-ik rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad/ khyad par sems can rnams kyi gti mug gi nyon mongs pa sbyangs te slar byon/ ling tshe shar du zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ rat+na dhṛk rin chen tog ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na nor bu/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad/

khyad par sems can rnams kyi nga rgyal gyi nyon mongs pa sbyangs te slar byon/ ling tshe lhor zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ a ro l̥k mtha' yas rdo rje can dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum gyi dang pos pad+ma kha 'byed pa/ lhag mas rdo rje dang*/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu dang bcas pa'i pad dmar/ rin chen/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad/ khyad par sems can rnams kyi 'dod chags kyi nyon mongs pa sbyangs te slar byon/ ling tshe nub tu zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ pradz+nyā dhṛk don yod rdo rje can ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na ral gri/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ pad ljang*/ nor bu/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad/ khyad par sems can rnams kyi phrag dog gi nyon mongs pa sbyangs te slar byon/ ling tshe byang du zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ mo ha ra ti/ spyan ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams kyi nad la sogs pa zhi bar mdzad de slar byon ling tshe mer zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ dwe ṣa ra ti/ mā ma kī nag mo nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje rtse dgu/ 'khor lo/ ut+pal sngon po/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/

des phyogs bcu'i sems can rnams kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgyas par mdzad de slar byon/ ling tshe'i srin por zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ rā ga ra ti/ gos dkar dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum gyi dang pos ut+pal kha 'byed pa dang*/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu dang bcas par ut+pal dmar po/ rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams srung bar mdzad de slar byon/ ling tshe'i rlung du zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ badz+ra ra ti/ sgrol ma ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ ut+pal sngo ser/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams dbang du mdzad de slar byon/ ling tshe'i dbang ldan du zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ rū pa badz+ra dzaḥ gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis me long*/ lhag ma'i g.yas rdo rje dang*/ ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis rin chen/ ral gri/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba bskyed slar byon/ ling tshe'i phyi'i mer zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ shap+ta badz+ra hūm̐/ sgra rdo rje ma ser mo ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis pi wang brdung ba/ lhag ma'i g.yas 'khor lo ut+pal sngon po/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis rin chen/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba bskyed slar byon/ ling tshe'i phyi'i srin por zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/

gan+dha badz+ra baṃ/ dri rdo rje ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis dri'i dung chos/ lhag ma'i g.yas rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba bskyed de slar byon/ ling tshe'i phyi'i rlung du zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ ra sa badz+ra hoḥ ro rdo rje ma ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis ro bcud kyi snod/ lhag ma'i g.yas 'khor lo/ ut+pal dmar po/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis rin chen/ ral gri/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcu'i sems can rnams kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba bskyed de slar byon/ ling tshe'i phyi'i dbang ldan du zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ spar+she badz+ra khaṃ/ reg bya rdo rje ma mthing ga mthing dmar nag pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba bskyed de slar byon/ gtso bo'i yum dang gnyis su med par thim/ maiṃ thiṃl/ byams pa dang sa snying dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi byams pa'i g.yas dang po klu shing gi me tog sa snying gi g.yas dang po 'khor lo/ lhag mas g.yas rdo rje/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can gyi skye mched rnam par sbyangs lha'i mig sogs dag par mdzad de slar byon/ lha snam nang ma'i shar du zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ oṃ/ phyag rdor dang nam snying ser po/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na/

nor bu/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can gyi skye mched rnam par sbyangs/ lha'i mig sogs dag par mdzad de slar byon/ lha snam nang ma'i lho ru zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ hūm̐/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'jam dbyangs dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum gyi dang pos pad+ma kha 'byed pa/ lhag mas rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu dang bcas pa'i pad dmar/ rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can gyi skye mched rnams par sbyang*/ lha'i mig sogs dag par mdzad de slar byon/ lha snam nang ma'i nub tu zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ saṃ/ sgrib sel dang kun bzang ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na ral gri/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ pad ljang*/ nor bu/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can gyi skye mched rnam par sbyangs/ lha'i mig sogs dag par mdzad de slar byon/ lha snam nang ma'i byang du zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ de thams cad zhi ba/ rin po che dang dar gyis klubs pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis 'od zer 'phreng ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ ya mān+ta kṛ ta/ gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub/ dril bu/ dgra s+t+wa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams kyi bgegs kyi tshogs bsdigs par mdzad de slar byon nas shar sgor/ pradz+nyān+ta kṛ ta/

shes rab mthar byed dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ dbyug pa/ ral gri/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub/ dril bu/ dgra s+t+wa/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams kyi bgegs kyi tshogs bsdigs par mdzad de slar byon nas lho sgor/ pad+man+ta kṛ ta/ pad+ma mthar byed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na pad+ma/ ral gri/ gtun shing*/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ dgra s+t+wa/ zhags pa/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams kyi bgegs kyi tshogs bsdigs par mdzad de slar byon nas nub sgor/ bigh+nan+ta kṛ ta/ bgegs mthar byed sngon po/ sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ gtun shing*/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub/ dril bu/ dgra s+t+wa/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams kyi bgegs kyi tshogs bsdigs par mdzad de slar byon nas byang sgor/ a tsa la/ mi g.yo ba mthing nag mthing dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na ral gri/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub/ dgra s+t+wa/ zhags pa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams kyi bgegs kyi tshogs bsdigs par mdzad de slar byon nas mer/ ṭak+ki rā dza/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po mthing nag mthing dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje/ ral gri/ g.yon gnyis zhags pa/ lcags kyu/ rin 'byung gi dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/

des phyogs bcur sems can rnams kyi bgegs kyi tshogs bsdigs par mdzad de slar byon nas bden bral du/ nī la daṇ+ḍa/ dbyug pa sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa/ pad+ma/ dgra s+t+wa/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams kyi bgegs kyi tshogs bsdigs par mdzad de slar byon nas rlung du/ ma hā ba la/ stobs po che nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa/ rtse gsum/ dgra s+t+wa/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams kyi bgegs kyi tshogs bsdigs par mdzad de slar byon nas byang shar du/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti/ gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gtsug tor spyi bor 'dzin pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis sdigs mdzub dang*/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams kyi bgegs kyi tshogs bsdigs par mdzad de slar byon nas steng du/ suṃ bhā rā dza/ gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin chen/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan pa phyung*/ des phyogs bcur sems can rnams kyi bgegs kyi tshogs bsdigs par mdzad de slar byon nas 'og tu/ de thams cad kyang shin tu khros pa'i zhal gdangs shing drag po'i gad rgyangs can/

mche ba gtsigs pa spyan dmar po gsum gzir zhing*/ sma ra ag tshom mer 'bar ba/ sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ yan lag rags pa/ dpal gyi chas kyis brgyan te zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas me'i phung po gcig tu 'bar ba'i dbus na pad nyi la bzhugs pa

legs par bsgom mo/ /de yan dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /bcu dgu pa ni/ rang gtso yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi gsang ba pad 'dab brgyad ze'u 'brur kā kha mu kha 'thon/ yab kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dbus rwar dung can gyi rtse 'thon nas de gnyis 'byar ba'i rtse mor yab yum gyi rlung gcig tu 'dres pa'i thig le phra mo yungs kar tsam dbus su brten pa lha rten gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gsal bar bsgom/ steng rlung rang sar bzhag srin po'i zhal bsdams thur sel dbang du bya'o// thur sel cung zad brtan nas lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bsnol/ gsang bar sa/ snying gar chu/ lkog mar me/ lte bar rlung*/ lus thams cad la gnas pa nam mkha'i rlung*/ ye shes lnga'i ngo bo zer lnga'i rnam pa can srog rtsol du gyur nas sna'i bu ga las dkyil 'khor bzhi'i kha dog go rim bzhin du 'bab pa oṃ yig 'jug pa āḥyig gnas pa hūṃ yig 'jug pa drag por 'jug pa dang*/ gnas pa steng rlung shugs rdzogs par lte 'og tu 'phul/ 'og glod/ ldang ba na dal bus phyir 'byin pa'o// de nas rlung dang rnam shes su ldan pa'i phra mo'o// mi ldan pa'i phra mo ni/ rang gi kun rdzob kyi sna rtser 'khor lo dkar po yungs 'bru'i tshad tsam rlung sems gcig tu bsgril nas rtag tu bsgom par bya'o/ /reg mthong gi mtshan ma rnyed pa'i tshe brtan pa yin la/ de nas bsgom pa la dbang du gyur pa'i phyir/ 'khor lo de gnyis dang gsum nas nam mkha' khyab pa'i bar du spro zhing bsdu bar bya'o/ /de ltar lobs nas/ de yongs su gyur pa'i rnam snang yang yum de brtan nas rigs kyi lha sems dpa' sogs kyis spro bsdu bya'o/ /de bzhin rigs gzhan bzhi la'o// de ni steng sgo la brten pa'i mtshan ma phra mo'i 'o// de nas rang dang phyag rgya sbyar ba'i rdo rje'i khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi thig le de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid du byas la bsgom mo// de la brten nas snyoms 'jug gi thig le phyung nas yum gyi pad+mar spros pas der rnam snang gis gtso bo byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gyur/

(de las kyang de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa spro zhing slar sdud par gyur/) phyir spro ba bu'i tshul dang*/ des kyang snyoms 'jug byas nas sngar bzhin nam mkha' khyab par byung ba tsha bo'i tshul/ de bzhin rigs gzhan rnams la yang ngo*// de ni 'og sgo la brten pa thig le'i phra mo'o// de nas snying ga'i pad+mar de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi mi shigs pa'i thig le yungs kar gyi 'bru tshad tsam la sems 'jug gnas ldang ba'i bzhon pa can zhen du bcug nas snang gsum gyi ye shes mngon du byas pa'i mthar mi shigs pa'i thig le mthong bar 'gyur la/ de brtan pa dang dkyil 'khor lnga'i rlung re re la rnam snang sogs dkyil 'khor re re'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas kyi sprin nam mkha' khyab par spro ba'o/ /de ni snying ga la brten pa mi shigs pa'i phra mo'o// nyi shu pa ni/ rlung nang du 'jug pa oṃ gyi rang bzhin can lus kyi bu ga tshun du sleb pa/ gnas pa hūm̐ gi rang bzhin can lus khrig gang ba/ ldang ba a'i rang bzhin can phyir rgyus pas lus stong lheb ste song bar bsam par rags pa'i rdor bzlas/ de nas rlung lnga ras bal kyi skud pa gzhibs pa lta bu gsang gnas nas lte ba'i bar du rta rnga tsam brang nge gnas pa/ phyir 'byung ba gang 'gro bar de skud pa'i sna nas 'then pa lta bu sor tshad ji tsam rgyu ba thug 'thon/ 'jug dus de nyid kyis sngar gyi rang mal du sleb/ gnas dus de khar bsdad par bsams pa phra ba'o// de nas mig gi lam nas ldang ba'i tshe gzugs sogs su gsal ba/ 'jug pa'i tshe gzugs sogs kyi snang ba nub pa/ gnas pa'i tshe yid kyi rnam shes rang mal du mi g.yo ba/ de lta bus rna ba sogs lhag ma rnams la yang shes par bya'o// gsal ba'i rlung zhes pa phra ba'o// de ltar rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim gyis rnam par mi rtog pa brtan pas rang bzhin gyis bzhon pa'i rlung rnams 'bab cing*/

der snang gsum gyi rim pas mi shigs pa'i thig le mthong ba la 'jug gnas ldang ba gsum gyis ldang la/ tshul de lta bu'i rlung gi rgyu ba 'gags nas 'od gsal la yun ring por gnas pa de la 'gog pa yang dag pa'i mtha' zer/ de nas las rlung thams cad zad pa na don dam rdo rje'i bzlas par 'gyur ro// nyer gcig pa ni/ rang gi thugs kar sa bon sngags kyis bskor ba/ de'i sngags las rlung ldang ba na 'od zer 'phro/ 'jug pa na sdud par bya zhing sngags sgra'i rnam par bsams nas ngag tu bzla ba ni dam tshig gi bzlas pa'o// yang na rang gi thugs kar sa bon la sngags kyis bskor ba/ de'i sngags las sngags phreng ldang ba na rang gi kha nas rdo rje'i lam/ de nas lha mo'i pad+ma/ de'i a wa dhū tī nas lha mo'i zhal/ 'jug pa de nas slar rang gi zhal du 'khor/ khyogs kyi bzlas pa/ 'di la zhi rgyas la yi ge lhod pa 'od zer dkar po bdud rtsi lta bu dang*/ ser po rin po che lta bu'i nus pa/ rang gi kha nas lha mo'i khar song pad+ma nas rdo rjer 'khor ba gdug cing rtsub pa'i yi ge khro bo'i bzlas pa ste drag shul gyi las la/ 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu dang*/ drag po spu gri'i so lta bus dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa 'phro ba'o// sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de kho na nyid/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+rik hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdzi na dz-ik oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrat+na dh+rik swā hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a ro l̥k āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ā pradz+nyā dhṛk hā hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmo ha ra ti laṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ra ti maṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrā ga ra ti pāṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ra ti tāṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra dzaḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥshap+ta badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgan+dha badz+ra baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥr sa badz+ra hoḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥspar+she badz+ra khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmai tri meṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥk+ṣi ti gar+bha thiṃl hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra pā ṇi oṃ hūm̐/

oṃ āḥkha gar+bha oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥlo ke shwa ra oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmañju shrī hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsarba ni wa ra ṇa biskaṃ bhi ni oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥs man+ta bhā dra saṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyān+ta kṛta huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpad+man+ta kṛta huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbighan+da kṛta huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a tsa la huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥṭak+ki rā dza huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥni la daṇ+ḍa huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm hā bā la huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsum+bha ra dza huṃ hūm̐/ zhes pa gtso 'khor gyi snying po yin la/ nye snying dang*/ 'phreng sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang bla ma'i man ngag las shes par bya'o// nyer gnyis pa ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen pos sems dpa' gsum cig car me long la has btab pa bzhin 'od gsal du thim/ nyer gsum pa ni/ lha mo bzhis gtso bo ma mthong nas gdung ba'i yid kyis blta 'dod de snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis spyan mas bskul ba ni/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs// dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la skyabs su gsol// mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na// sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ mā ma kīs/ rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan// sangs rgyas don du byang chub mchog bsgrub rab tu phan par gzigs// mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na// 'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ gos dkar mos/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan pa'i thugs brtse ba// 'jig rten dag gi dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la shin tu brtson/ mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na// spyod pa dri med kun tu bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol// sgrol mas/

khyod ni rdo rje'i 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan yon che// yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam nyid gzigs// mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na// yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol// zhes bskul bas sngon gyi smon lam dang thugs rje'i shugs kyis 'od gsal zung 'jug gi sku sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid can sngar ji ltar bar bzhengs pa dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis mthong bar 'gyur ro// nyer bzhi pa ni/ de nas de thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu/ rigs lnga'i sgo nas bstod pa/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// gsang ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che// rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che// mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa mnyes// rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung*// rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo// snying kha nas 'phros pas gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe nas shap+ta= oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ shap+ta= gan+dhe= ra sa= spar+she= ces nyer spyod lngas phyi mchod dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga btab pa'i chang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bdud rtsi'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud rnams/

shar du go las ba glang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bi las dri chen/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du ma las klad pa/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ shar du bh+rūm̐/ lhor āṃ/ nub tu dz+rīṃ/ byang du khaṃ/ dbus su hūm̐/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse dgu pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung gi ba dan la phog rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa bsregs/ dag pa zhu zhing khol ba'i rlangs pa oṃ dang hūm̐ la phog oṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa thod par lhung ba'i rlangs pa dang*/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur/ rdo rje zla ba oṃ dang bcas pa thod par lhung ste/ zhu nas dam tshig gi bdud rtsir 'dres pa/ hūm̐ gis sbyangs/ yi ge āḥs rtogs par byas/ oṃ gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bsnan pas sbyar ba kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs te/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje dkar po sbu gu can gyis drangs te gsol bar gyur par bsam nas/ bdud rtsi myang ba nang mchod dang*/ de nas reg bya rdo rje ma dang*/ de nas rnam snang la sogs pa'i nga rgyal gyis yum bzhi la rjes su chags pas snyoms par 'jug cing*/ mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bas 'od gsal ba'i ngo bo nyid du ro gcig pa/ gsang mchod do// dkyil 'khor gyi yongs su dag pa ni/ 'phags pa'i bden bzhi ngos bzhir 'gyur// tshangs pa'i gnas ni grwa yin no// bsdu ba'i dngos po zhes bya sgo// bzhi yi ming can re re ste// dad pa'i dbang po la sogs sems// rnam pa lnga po yang dag 'byung*// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i sgo khyud ni// bzhi ste de yang rnam pa bzhi// de yi dbus kyi 'khor lo gang*// dkyil 'khor brgyad kyis gzhal ba ni// rnam par thar pa brgyad yin te// dngos grub thams cad sgrub byed pa'o// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad pa ni// ka ba brgyad ces bya bar bshad// sangs rgyas kun gyi khang chen du// thams cad tshe na ka bar 'gyur// chos dang de nyid don gyi brda// 'khor lo'i nang gi dkyil 'khor ro// thugs kyi dkyil 'khor 'di de ni// thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog/

ces rten dang*/ phung po lnga yi rang bzhin du// sangs rgyas lnga rnams rab brtan bya// spyan ma la sogs lha mo bzhi// sa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin no// de ni 'dod yon lnga'i ngo bor// gzugs rdo rje la sogs pa'o// mig la sogs pa'i rang bzhin du// sa yi snying po la sogs so// lag sogs ngo bor khro dbang po// gshin rje'i dgra sogs brten par bya/ zhes lha'i yongs dag brten no/ de ltar phung po la sogs pa'i don ji lta ba bstan cing*/ de nas thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnams rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la bcug mgon po yab yum gcig pur bzhugs pa/ nyer lnga pa ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi 'od zer 'phros/ des sems can thams cad la dbang bskur sgrib pa dag nas yi ge hūm̐ du gyur cing des nam mkha' gang ba thams cad rdo rje 'chang du gyur pa yid kyis bltas te spyod lam la 'jug go/ nyer drug pa ni/ bsgoms pas lus dub na/ rang gi spyi bo las mtho gang tsam gyi mtho bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ dkar po mgo bo mthur du bstan pa bdud rtsi lnga 'dzag pas rkang pa'i mthil nas spyi bo'i bar gang bar bsams te des lus rgyas par 'gyur ro/ zas sbyang ba sngar bzhin/ lkog ma dung dmar po'i rnam pa la hrīḥlas pad ma 'dab brgyad la hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dbus oṃ 'od zer zas la 'phro bar bsam la lkog ma sbyang ba/ snying gar pad nyir hūm̐ sngon po rtse gsum gyi me rab tu 'phro ba/ der lag pa dgang blugs su mos te oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis drangs nas snying ga'i me dbus kyi lha thams cad 'dus pa'i rang bzhin hūm̐ la 'bul ba'i tshul gyis za ba nang gi sbyin sreg de yang gsang bar yaṃ las rlung*/ lte bar raṃ las me/ snying gar laṃ las sa/ mgrin par baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor bsams te rlung kha sbyar/

rlung gis sbar ba'i mes sa bsregs/ des chu bskol te zhu bar gyur pa'i dwangs ma rnams gtum mo'i me la sbyin sreg byas pas snyigs ma rnams thal bar song ste rlung ro bsal bas snyigs ma 'og sgo nas 'thon nas thal bar gyur par bsam mo// des rims dang nad kyi dug la sogs pas mi tshugs dus min par 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro// phyi nang gi sbyin sreg yi ge gsum mam phreng ba'i sngags la sogs pa dad rdzas kyi sbyor bas rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par sbyar ba byas nas las thams cad bsgrub pa zhes bya ba rnams ni las kyi rgyal po mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin no//

// ༈ gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgo nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/ gsang sngags gtso bor byed pa'i slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ bsam gtan la gzhol ba'i slob dpon gyi bya ba'o// dang po ni/ klu'i byang chub kyis/ dang por sa ni sbyang ba dang*// de nas sa yongs 'dzin pa dang*// phyi nas bgegs ni nyer zhi dang*// thod le kor gyis thig gdab dang*// de nas sa lha sogs lhag par// gnas dang de nas gsol gdab dang*// phyi nas slob ma lhag gnas dang*// nam mkhar thig ni gdab pa dang*// tshon sna lnga yi cho ga dang*// tshon rtsi rnams ni dgye ba dang*// lha rnams spyan drangs nyid dang ni// de nas slob ma gzhug pa dang*// khrus kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga dang*// de nas sangs rgyas dbang bskur dang*// de nas phyag mtshan dbang bskur dang*// bla ma lha dang yon gnyis dang*// rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa dang*// de nas gshegs gsol cho ga dang*// dkyil 'khor las phyed phur pa dang*// skud pa bsku ba nyid dang ni// rab bshad cho ga nyi shu yi// ji lta ji ltar rgyas shes pa'i// rdo rje slob dpon mkhas pa yis// rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// zhes gsungs pa'i dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor bya 'os pa khang bzang sogs sam/ gsar pa'i sar pus nub tsam brko zhing ro lnga bsal shis pa'i sas stegs bu bya// ba lang gi lci bas byug dri chus bsangs/ drag po'i sbyin sreg bya/ badz+ra satwa zhes zlos shing rdo rje'i blta bas phyogs thams cad du blta bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ gnas brgyan/ rang chas gos dkar po dang ldan pas gtsug tor dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te sa la dri bzang byugs pa'i cha la thog mar nyi ma gsum du gtor chog bzhin gtor ma 'bul lo// de nas bgegs zhi bar bya ba'i phyir phyogs skyong la gtor ma 'bul bar bya ste/ rang nyid skad cig gis mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po/ sngo dmar dkar ba'i

sogs/ nas/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ ces nga rgyal gzung la/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud rnams/ shar du go las ba glang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bi las dri chen/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du ma las klad pa/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ shar du bh+rūm̐/ lhor āṃ/ nub tu dz+rīṃ/ byang du khaṃ/ dbus su hūm̐/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse dgu pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung gi ba dan la phog rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa bsregs/ dag pa zhu zhing khol ba'i rlangs pa oṃ dang hūm̐ la phog oṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa thod par lhung ba'i rlangs pa dang*/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur/ rdo rje zla ba oṃ dang bcas pa thod par lhung ste/ zhu nas dam tshig gi bdud rtsir 'dres pa/ hūm̐ gis sbyangs/ yi ge āḥs rtogs par byas/ oṃ gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bsnan pas sbyar ba kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong ba dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ da sha dig bh+yaḥs+thi ti bh+yaḥ i ha a ba s+thi te bh+yaḥtsa de wa nā ga

yak+ṣa/ gan+dharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin+ni ra/ ma ho ra ga bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ un+man+ta/ a pa sma ra/ oṃ sta ra ga a ti/ bh+yo ba li tāṃ pa ya/ mi gṛ hī twā su kha sau man s+ye lā/ bi no bha wan+tu s+thā nī/ tsa ni ru ba dra/ kurban+tu/ sarba bud+dha a dhi nin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ i daṃ a mṛ ta biṇ+ḍi bhu ka to ma ma sa pa ri wā ri shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ces lan gsum gyis phul la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ= puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ phyogs bcur rnam par gnas rnams dang*// 'dir ni kun tu gnas pa dang*// lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*// dri za lha min nam mkha' lding*// mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye che// 'byung po yi dwags sha za dang*// smyo byed dang ni rjed byed dang*// gnon po la sogs pa rnams la// gtor ma 'bul gyis bsnams nas kyang*// bde dang yid bde thob gyur cig /gnas 'dir nyer 'tshe med par mdzod// sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs kyis// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bdud rtsi yi// bza' ba la ni longs spyad nas// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swā hā/ zhes 'dod don gsol la/ gtor ma dang mchod pa gshegs/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ de nas sa yongs su sbyong ba'i phyir/ slob dpon dbus nas shar du phyogs par 'khod nas/ rang gi snying khar pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis sogs nas/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin song ba'i rjes su/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ sogs nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ khams gsum skyod pa las grol mkha' dang mnyam yur dngos po'i ngo bo nyid// dag cing zhi la rnam dben mchog gi rnal 'byor pa nyid yul// rtogs dka' brtag par dka' la bdag gzhan rab phan khyab cing mtshan ma med// rgyal ba'i bde ba mnyam med mnyam sku mi rtog yul gcig la phyag 'tshal//

ces pas bstod/ spos dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni che ge rdo rje can// 'dir ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal// sangs rgyas la sogs kun byon la// 'dir ni dngos grub stsal du gsol// dkyil 'khor chen po'i las rnams ni// ji ltar nus pa rab tu bgyi// ces snyan gsan dbab/ de nas slob mas kyang dbang bskur 'grub pa'i don du phyogs bzhi nas/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs cing*/ rgyas par na mdun bskyed skabs su 'byung ba ltar/ chu gsum nyer spyod rol mor bcas sam/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra dhṛk oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// sogs kyis bstod la/ shar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// lho nas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// nub nas/ zhi ba'i mchog ni chos las byung*// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// byang nas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhi dag cing dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur// dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// thun mong nas/ khyod zhabs pad+ma ma gtogs par// gtso bo gzhan na skyabs ma mchis// thub pa bdag ni 'khor ba las// bsgral ba'i phyir du dkyil 'khor bri// zhes gsol ba gdab tu 'jug go /gsum pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa ba byung dang dri bzang pos byugs/ me tog sil ma bkram/ rang chas gos dmar po dang ldan zhing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te kha shar du phyogs pas skyil krung gis 'dug ste/

slob dpon gyis rdo rje khu tshur las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ba'i rtse mo sbyar ba mthur blta spyi bor bzung la/ hūm̐ badz+ra ut+tiṣ+ṭha/ bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje khro bo'i 'khor gyis bskor ba/ bsrung 'khor bzhin du bsgoms pa'i rkang mthil gnyis su rdo rje/ mig g.yon ṭa las zla ba g.yas ma las nyi ma/ mig 'bras hūm̐ me ltar 'bar ba/ rdo rje'i blta bas phyogs thams cad du blta ba la/ hūm̐ yig drag po glur len pas bgegs thams cad bkug ste bka' bsgo ba/ a pa sa ran+tu/ bha wan+to/ yo ga tsit+ta/ de bā/ a su ra/ yak+ṣa/ rāk+shā sa/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ a pasmar/ bhu ta/ ḍā kī nī/ ostā ra ga mahā l+li ka a nu tsa ra pra tiṣ+ṭha/ ga ru ḍa/ kiṃ pu ru ṣa/ man+t+ra/ sid+dhi/ bdag gis sa phyogs 'dir slob ma che ge mo rdzogs pa'i byang chub rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o// rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i bka' stsal pa 'di thos nas myur du dengs shig gang zhig mi dengs pa de mgo bo ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po 'bar ba hūm̐ gi rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis tshal ba brgyar 'gas par bya'o// lan gsum brjod nas khro bas hūm̐ yig phyag rgya dang bcas pas shar du g.yas brkyang*/ lhor g.yon brkyang*/ nub tu sa ga dbus zlum po tsam mam mnyam pa'i stang stabs nas rgyab tu phyogs pa'i tshul zhes bshad pa'i bar thams cad bya'o// de nas seng ldeng gi phur bu sor brgyad la tshon skud lnga bcings pa dri dang me tog la sogs pas mchod nas snod gsar par bzhag lag pas reg cing oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge gsum mngon par bsngags/ de ltar 'dus byas pa'i phur bu slar oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ sogs nas/ khams gsum yang de bzhin nyid la zhugs par gyur/

slar yang*/ rgyal ba rnams kyis rnam par spyod mdzad pas// sems can phyir yin las sbyang bya phyir min// 'di na bgegs yod ma yin bdud rnams sam// rtog pas 'phel byed byin rlabs 'grub med nyid// bdag bdud nyid dam bstan pa nyid ma 'gre// bstan pa nyid phyir rjes su bstan mi bya// rang bde ba bsgrub sdug bsngal gyis mi gang*// byang chub mchog rab myur phyir bstan par bya// zhes pas so// bzhi pa ni/ tshangs las mnyam g.yon mnyam pa gsum// dang po gshags nang de'i phyi yang*// phyi ma bzhi dor gnyis pa bzhag gsum pa bshags nang dbus dor phyi// phyed dang phyi ma gdab par bya// rtsig nang phyed du re mig dgu// mda' sgo 'dzom steng gcig dbus gnyis// gcig 'dzom nas drug steng gsum bskor// yang mnyam phyed kyi dbus gzhag par// rtsa gnyis rtse mo gcig tu bya// gcig gcig sgo tshad khor yug dang*// rdo phreng gnyis la ka brgyad kyis// lnga pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bya rgyu'i phyogs der bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas/ bsrung 'khor bzhin phur bu btab nas/ nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i rnam pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ thams cad kyi steng 'og hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de thams cad gcig tu gyur pa las rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur gyi bar byas la/ mdun du me tog gi tshom bu mtha' mchod pas bskor bar byas/ skyobs pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang*// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seṅge skyobs pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri//

zhes brjod/ thal mo sa la brdabs pas sa'i lha mo gser btso ma'i mdog can sku phyed tsam sa nas 'thon pa la/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wī ar+ghaṃ pad+yāṃ puṣ+pe dhu pe ā lo ke gan+dhai nai wid+ya shap+ta/ rnams kyis mchod pas mnyes nas/ rig pa 'dzin pa de ltar gyis shig ces gnang ba sbyin nas de nyid du thim/ sa lha lhag gnas so// de nas thig btab pa'i lha gnas su dri zhim pos byugs/ gtso ba'i gnas su gru bzhi dang*/ lha gzhan sum cu'i gnas su zlum po re byas la lha so so'i sngags rjod bzhin me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i mthar mchod pas rgyas par bskor/ gal te zhag gis bar chod na/ dang po'i sbyor ba yan nam/ ting nge 'dzin gsum rdzogs pa nyer bsdu de nyid kyi bar bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung bsgom la/ bsangs sbyangs/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid nam mkha'i khams zhes pa nas/ pad nyi la bzhugs pa bar mdun bskyed bzhin dang*/ de nas/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs/ rang rang gi sar bzhugs su gsol ba la snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo nam mkha'i khams khyab pa rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod yon sngon du 'gro bas/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed cing*// sogs mdun bskyed ltar nyer spyod lngas mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// sogs de nyid lngas bstod/ lha lhag gnas so// de nas gser dngul lam zangs sam sa las byas pa'i bum pa mtshan ldan chu gtsang mas sum gnyis dgang ba nyer lnga pa'i rdzas bcug pa/ shing bzang po'i yal gas kha brgyan/ srad bu dkar po can/ gos dkar pos mgul ching gur gum la sogs pas lha'i mtshan ma bkod la/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa dkyil 'khor gyi grwa dang khor yug gi nang*/

gcig sgor/ med na dbus sam lngar/ rnam rgyal dang las thams cad pa gnyis/ rnam rgyal gyi steng du dung chos/ bgegs mthar byed kyis bsangs la/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad ldan pa/ oṃ tap+te tap+te ma hā tap+te swā hā/ lha'i chu bo gaṅga bkug /des gang bar bsam/ bum pa so sor/ gnyis las med na rnam rgyal dung chos su thams cad/ las bum du bgegs mthar byed bsam/ bum nang mtshan ma rnams rdo rje 'chang reg bya rdo rje ma dang snyoms par 'jug pas pad nyi'i gdan la sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ de dang dus mnyam par shar du rnam snang*/ lhor rin 'byung*/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don grub/ mer spyan ma/ bden bral du mā ma kī/ rlung du gos dkar mo/ dbang ldan du sgrol ma/ rim pa gnyis pa'i me nas brtsams pa'i mtshams su gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ sgra rdo rje ma dang*/ dri rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ rim pa gsum pa'i nang ma'i shar nas g.yas bskor gyis/ byams pa/ sa snying*/ phyag rdor/ nam snying*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs/ sgrib sel/ kun bzang*/ shar du gshin rje gshed/ lhor shes rab mthar byed/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed/ byang du bgegs mthar byed/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can/ byang shar du stobs po che/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ las bum du bgegs mthar byed rnams skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/

zhes lhag mos bzhin bskyed/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs// oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dgug bzhug bcing mnyes par byas/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pas dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa ni/ snying kha nas 'phros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ lha mo zla ba ltar dkar gzugs// mtshar sdug lang tshos snyems pa'i gar// me tog phreng bas sgrib zol gyis// mtho ris mdun sa bzhin du mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lha mo nam mkha' ltar mthing gzugs// dri zhim ngad pa 'thul ba'i gar// bdug spos phreng bas= mtho ris mdun sa= sngags thog mtha' gong bzhin sbyar te/ dhu pe= lha mo mtshams sprin ltar dmar gzugs// nyin byed 'bum gyi 'od 'phro'i gar// mar me phreng bas= mtho ris mdun sa= ā lo ke= lha mo margad ltar ljang gzugs// reg pas sim byed byug pa'i gar// dri chab phreng bas= mtho ris mdun sa= gan+dhe= lha mo gser ltar ser ba'i gzugs// ma mchu'i ro brgya mngar ba'i gar// zhal zas phreng bas= mtho ris mdun sa= nai wid+ya= lha mo bai ḍūr ltar sngo gzugs// snyan 'gyur glu sgra sgrog pa'i gar// rol mo'i phreng bas= mtho ris mdun sa= oṃ āḥbadz+ra shap+ta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang*/ gzugs sogs rgyal ba rnam snang mdzad// bde chen gcig las du ma'i gar// brtan g.yo'i rnam pa thams cad pas// dkyil 'khor mchod par bgyi bar 'tshal// oṃ badz+ra rū pa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

sgra gsum he ru ka dpal mgon// bde chen= rol mo dbyang snyan thams cad pas// dkyil 'khor= oṃ badz+ra shap+ta= dri gsum rdo rje nyin mor byed// bde chen= dri zhim byug spos thams cad pas// dkyil 'khor= oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe= ro gsum pad+ma gar gyi dbang*// bde chen= ro mchog bza' btung thams cad pas// dkyil 'khor= oṃ badz+ra rā sa= reg gsum don yod grub pa dngos// bde chen= bsam las bde 'byung thams cad pas// dkyil 'khor= oṃ badz+ra spar+she huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces mchod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// sogs nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ hūm̐/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhes las kyi lhar bstod/ bdud rtsi ni/ hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ laṃ māṃ paṃ tāṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ maiṃ thiṃl/ oṃ oṃ oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ saṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi phul/ hūm̐ zhes lag pa g.yon pas dril bu dang bcas pa'i rdo rje la btags pa'i me tog gi phreng ba gzung*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛk hūṃ hūm̐/ zhes gtso ba'i snying po brgya rtsa brgyad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yi ge gsum de mnyam/ oṃ badz+ra u ta ka hūm̐/ zhes pa de yang de bzhin bzla/ yig brgya lan bdun gyis brtan par byas/ yab yum 'dod chags chen po'i mes zhu nas byang chub sems kyi ngo bo gyur te chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ gtso bo'i sngags dang hūm̐ lan bdun bzlas pa'i rjes la mchod yon gyi chu cung zad cig der phul/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i me tog dkar po gsum bzhag de bzhin du bum pa so so'i steng du rdo rje me tog gi phreng ba spos nas rang rang gi sngags nyi shu rtsa re bzlas gzhan 'dra'o// las thams cad par bgegs mthar byed kyi snying po/

oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛta huṃ hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ khro bo bgegs mthar byed kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar de srid du bgegs rnams srung bar mdzad du gsol// ces brjod/ bum pa lhag gnas so/ drug pa ni/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol bas/ bar snang la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas dang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor ba rnams la go rim bzhin bltas nas/ tshig 'di brjod do/ /deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bur bcas// bdag gis gson pa 'bras bur bcas// bdag ni dam tshig lha rnams dang*// mnyam par 'gyur ba the tshom med// byang chub sems dpa' sems gcig pa// bdag ni phyir mi ldog par 'gyur// bdag deng de bzhin gshegs pa yi// rigs su skye bar gdon mi za// sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs pas// deng du bdag gi nyi ma mchog /de dag mchod sbyin bla na med// deng du bdag gi 'dus pa mchog/ de nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod yon sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dhu pe sogs nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'bul ba nang gi mchod pas mchod de/ 'di skad brjod do/ /ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs// rdo rje can bdag che ge mo/ /zhes ni bgyi bas dkyil 'khor bri// sangs rgyas kun deng gshegs su gsol// dngos grub 'di ni stsal du gsol// dkyil 'khor chen po'i las la ni// ci nus bzhin du rab tu bgyi// de nas snyems pa dang bcas pas langs shing rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i nga rgyal 'chang bas 'gro zhing*/ bdag nyid rang nyid rdo rje can// rdo rje sems dpa' bdag rang nyid// bdag ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che// bdag ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal// bdag ni phyag na rdo rje brtan// bdag ni bdag po rdo rje che// deng bdag rdo rje sems dpar grub// de nas sangs rgyas lnga'i rigs byung rnams la gsol ba btab pa/

mdun gyi lha nam mkhar yid kyis btegs nas/ thugs rje yi ni bdag cag bdag /slob ma rjes su 'dzin brtse dang*// khyed cag la yang mchod slad du// sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal// bcom ldan gus pas bdag la ni// de phyir bka' drin mdzad par 'os// rdo rje can bdag che ge mo/ /zhes bgyi'i dkyil 'khor mdzes pa ni// che ge ci nus yo byad kyis// sang ni yang dag 'dri bar 'gyur// de phyir slob ma bcas bdag la// rjes su brtse bas nyer gzung nas// 'khor bcas kun gyi dkyil 'khor la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// bdun pa ni/ 'gro ba 'don pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pas slob ma rnams shar sgor bos/ lag tu me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ pus mo btsugs/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sngon du byas pa la mchod nas thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po yis// byang chub tu ni nges byas te// tshul khrims rnam gsum bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni bsdu ba dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims te// so sor bdag nyid brtan por gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi mchog

/sdom pa sangs rgyas sbyor skyes pa// dang po mchog tu gzung bar bgyi// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni// so sor de bzhin nyid du gzung*// rdo rje chen po'i rigs mchog la// slob dpon nyid du gzung bar bgyi// dam tshig nyid du dag pa yi// rin chen 'byung ba'i rigs mchog la// nyin re dus drug byas nas su// sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin par bya// byang chub chen po 'byung ba yi// pad+ma chen po'i rigs dag la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi// sdom pa thams cad dang ldan pa// ji ltar nus pas mchod pa'i las// las kyi rig mchog chen po la// de bzhin nyid du so sor gzung*// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// mchog tu bskyed par byas nas su// sems can thams cad don byed phyir// sdom pa ma lus gzung bar bgyi// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces pa'i bar gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung*/ de nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa can la/ so shing 'o ma can gyi shing las byung ba sor bcu gnyis pa gsar pa ma gas pa rtse mor me tog bcings pa rtsa ba so la drud tshul gyi/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa ha/ slob ma kha byang shar du bltas pas dor/ rtse mo phyogs gang du bstan pa brtags te las de dang de 'grub par brda sprod/ de nas ku sha gtsang ma stan dang sngas kyi phyir/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa baṃ zhes pas sbyin/ bu mos bkal ba'i skud pa gsum bsgril la hūm̐ gis sngags pa dpung pa g.yas par bcing*/ oṃ bud+dhā mai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarbān swā hā/ bsrung*/ de nas slob ma'i snying gar hūm̐/ mgrin par āḥspyi bor oṃ zhes bris thig le bya/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma rnams su gyur/ slar yang dri chus oṃ āḥhūm̐

'du bya ba/ de nas khyor chu oṃ hrīḥ bi shud+dha sarba dharma sar+b+ba pā pā ni tswa s+ya shodha ya sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūm̐/ lan gsum 'thungs nas lhag ma rgyab tu dor/ de nas slob ma de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i phyir dang*/ de bzhin nyid kyi don dran pa dang rnam par g.yeng ba nye bar zhi ba'i phyir du bshad pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos bstan pa// bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten// 'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang*// dam pa'i don gyi bden pa'o// zab mo nyid ni rnam mi rtog /rgya che sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku// zab dang rgya che zhes grags pa// bden pa gnyis zhes bya bar bshad// kun rdzob dang ni dam pa'i don// rnam dbye so sor shes nas ni// phyis nas slar bsre bya ba ste// go 'phang zad pa med pa bsgom// de yi kun tu kun las kun// rnam kun kun tshe rang nyid ni// sangs rgyas thams cad rang bzhin du// grub pa rang nyid kyis mthong 'gyur// byang chub sus kyang byin ma yin// su yi kyang ni bzung ma yin// rang chos yongs su shes pa las// 'di la sangs rgyas sangs rgyas brjod// sems can bag la nyal dbye bas// yang dag mgon pos de nyid ni// 'bad pas sbas nas phung po ni// rin chen za ma tog tu bzhag /de phyir bla ma'i zhabs kyi ni// drin gyis 'bad pas rtogs byas te// de nyid kyis yid gsal gyur pas// de nas spyod pa rab tu bya// 'di nas gtsang sbra nges sdom med// dka' thub med cing dka' spyad med// dka' spyad med cing nges med la// bde ba bstan pas 'grub par 'gyur// dkyil 'khor dam pa mthong nas ni// bskal pa bye ba mtha' yas su// sngon chad sdig pa gang byas pa// de dag thams cad zad par 'gyur/ de nas ku sha che ba stan/ chung ba sngas su gyis la nyol la rmi lam legs nyes gang byung ba de nga la smos shig ces brjod/ nang par dris la ngan na bdag med pa'i gtam gyis sbyang bar bya'o// brgyad pa ni/

dkyil 'khor gyi tshad gnyis 'gyur kha dog lnga pa sangs rgyas lnga bsgom/ hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā/ sa bon de bzlas pas rigs lnga spyan drangs de la thim/ de nas thig skud 'od zer lnga'i bdag nyid can du bsgoms nas/ bla ma mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal gyis slob ma rnam snang gi nga rgyal can la rtse mo gtad/ oṃ dīp+ta tri ṣ+ṭi aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ a n+yo n+yā nu ga tā/ sar+b+ba dhar+m+māḥ pa ra spa ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭāḥ sar+b+ba dharmāḥ a t+yan+tu u nu pra biṣ+ṭāḥ sar+b+ba dharmāḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bsgril/ gtsang ma'i snod du bzhag dri la sogs pas mchod/ yi ge gsum gyis mngon par bsngags langs te 'khor lo sgyur ba'i sgeg dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor mchod/ slob dpon mi bskyod par gsal ba'i mig gnyis dzaḥl nyi zla dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ zhes rdo rje khu tshur lte bar gzung*/ rtse mo slob ma la gtad nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā/ rdo rjes 'gros kyis sngar bzhin mkha' dang sa la gdab/ yi ge gsum gyi mthar badz+ra muḥ btags pas thig skud kyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dgu pa ni/ tshon rnams dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ rdo rje'i blta bas sbar te sangs rgyas lnga rig ma sa bon dang bcas pa gzugs sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don mdzad par bsam/ hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā bzlas dri sogs kyis mchod/ snod gsar par bzhag slar oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐/ bzlas so// bcu pa ni/ de nas nang par slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal gyis dbang ldan nas brtsams khu tshur g.yon pas dbye ste/ dbus kyi re mig sngon po/ gzhan pa'i re mig dang snam bu/ 'dod snam dmar/ gzhan spyi mthun/ nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'od zer phreng ba kha dog lnga pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phreng ba sngon po/ rdo rje dkar po/ ka ba la phyogs kyi rigs kyi phyag mtshan/ re khā sbom phra sogs kyi skyon spangs la bri'o// mtshan ma ngan na sngar bzhin gyis sbyang ngo*// bcu gcig pa ni/

de nas dkyil 'khor de la gdul bya'i dbye bas phyag rgya gsum gang 'os dgod par bya'o// dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' mchod pas bskor/ rdul tshon lhag ma yi ge gsum gyi mthar muḥ bzlas te/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ de nas bum pa rnams spos dang rol mor bcas pas g.yas bskor lan gsum mthar/ gtso bum shar sgo'i g.yas dang*/ las bum g.yon/ bum pa gzhan rnams phyogs so sor ma 'khrul bar dgod/ mchod pa'i yo byad lha yi grangs dang mnyam pa sogs rgyas sdus gang 'dzoms dang*/ gzhan yang ye shes 'jig rten gyi mchod gtor dang*/ rgyan gyi bye brag ci 'byor ba legs par bkram/ dbang gi chas con pan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ gsang dbang gi thod pa bdud rtsi lnga dang dri bzang sbyar ba/ mig thur/ me long*/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ rigs tsaka slob ma mchod pa nyer spyod na bza' bcas dang*/ mig dar/ me tog dung chos/ khrus kyi yo byad/ tshogs kyi mchod pa sogs phyag len bzhin du bkod/ ras bris kyi cho ga la ni/ thig tshon gyi bya ba mi dgos shing gzhan gong ltar la/ bum pa gnyis las med na/ sgo yi g.yas g.yon du 'god par gsung*/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngos la 'jug par skyabs sems sngon du song nas bdag gi rnal 'byor nyer bsdu'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin rdzogs par bsgom/ de nas/

bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po/ zhes pa nas bdag gi rnal 'byor spyod lam la 'jug pa'i bar bya'o// rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor las thams cad pas bsang gtor lan gsum byas/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bha wa āt+mako3haṃ/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i khams gyi dbus yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i rnam pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ thams cad kyi steng 'og hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de thams cad gcig tu gyur pa las rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de'i dbus su bh+rūṃ las dpag tshad brgya'i tshad tsam gyi rin po che'i rang bzhin gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhin thig bzhi dang ldan pa/ ka ba brgyad kyis mdzes pa/ lha dang mi'i las khyad par du 'phags pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bzhugs pa'i mchod rten/ mdzes pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ nang gi lha'i gnas su zla ba nyi ma'i gdan 'khod pa'i dbus su/ sa bon bkod yod na/ hūm̐ oṃ swā ā hā/ laṃ maṃ paṃ tāṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ/ maiṃ thiṃlaṃ/ oṃ aṃ/ oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ saṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang phyag mtshan bkod yod na/ de dang de las rdo rje in+d+ra nī li'i 'od can/ shar du 'khor lo dkar po/ lhor rin po che ser po/ nub tu pad+ma dmar po/ byang du ral gri ser po/ shar gyi grwar 'khor lo/ lho'i grwar rdo rje/ nub kyi grwar pad+ma/ byang gi grwar ut+pal/ phyi'i me nas me long*/ srin por pi wang*/ rlung du dri'i phung po/ dbang ldan du ro snod/

gtso bo'i mdun du reg bya/ shar gyi snam bur klu shing dang*/ 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che gnyis/ nub tu pad+ma gnyis/ byang du ral gri gnyis/ shar sgor tho ba/ lhor dbyug pa/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du rdo rje/ me rlung dbang ldan gsum du ral gri/ srin por zhags pa/ steng 'og gnyis la rdo rje/ de rnams 'od zer 'bar ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha bkod yod na sa bon las phyag mtshan/ de las lha lhag mos bzhin te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las dbus su rdo rje 'chang reg bya rdo rje ma dang snyoms par 'jug pas pad nyi'i gdan la sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ de dang dus mnyam par shar du rnam snang*/ lhor rin 'byung*/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don grub/ mer spyan ma/ bden bral du mā ma ki rlung du gos dkar mo/ dbang ldan du sgrol ma/ rim pa gnyis pa'i me nas brtsams pa'i mtshams su gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ sgra rdo rje ma dang*/ dri rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ rim pa gsum pa'i snam bur shar nas g.yas bskor gyis/ byams pa/ sa snying*/ phyag rdor/ nam snying*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs/ sgrib sel/ kun bzang*/ shar sgor gshin rje gshed/ lho sgor shes rab mthar byed/ nub sgor pad+ma mthar byed/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal/ nub byang du dbyug sngon/ byang shar du stobs po che/ steng du gtsug gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ rim pa gsum ga'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe/ nas/ shap+ta= oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ shap+ta= gan+dhe= ra sa= spar+she= de ltar dri sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pas mchod/ rang gi sems kyi sprul pa'i rig ma

'am phyi rol gyi bu mo dang lhan cig de'i dbus na bdag nyid mi bskyod pa sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin po che/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ de'i spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin oṃ dkar po gzugs kyi phung po/ mgrin par 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin āḥdamar po 'du shes kyi phung po/ snying gar mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin hūṃ sngon po rnam shes kyi phung po/ lte bar rin 'byung gi rang bzhin swa ser po tshor ba'i phung po/ rkang pa gnyis la don grub kyi rang bzhin hā ljang khu 'du byed kyi phung po/ mo hā ra ti spyan ma sa'i khams la/ dwe ṣa ra ti mā ma kī chu'i khams la/ rā ga ra ti gos dkar mo me'i khams la/ badz+ra ra ti sgrol ma rlung gi khams la/ thiṃl sa snying mig gi skye mched la/ oṃ phyag rdor rna ba'i skye mched la/ oṃ nam snying rna ba'i skye mched la/ oṃ 'jig rten dbang phyug lce'i skye mched la/ hūm̐ 'jam dpal yid kyi skye mched la/ oṃ sgrib sel lus kyi skye mched la/ maiṃ byams pa rtsa rgyus la/ saṃ kun tu bzang po tshigs thams cad la/ hūm̐ gshin rje mthar byed lag pa g.yas/ hūm̐ shes rab mthar byed g.yon par/ hūm̐ pad+ma mthar byed khar/ hūm̐ bgegs mthar byed gsang ba'i rdo rjer/ hūm̐ mi g.yo ba dpung pa g.yas/ hūm̐ 'dod rgyal g.yon par/ hūm̐ dbyug sngon can pus mo g.yas/ hūm̐ stobs po che g.yon/ hūm̐ gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba spyi bor/ hūm̐ gnod mdzes rgyal po rkang gnyis la/ phyag rgya mā ma kī sngon mo sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum rdo rje rtse dgu/ 'khor lo/ ut+pal sngon po/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar swā/ rkang par hā/

rigs lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi yum bzhi/ skye mched sems ma lnga/ lag pa g.yas par ro langs ma/ g.yon par gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ kha la khro gnyer can ma/ bha gar ral gcig ma/ dpung pa g.yas par de bzhin gshegs yum rdo rje ma/ g.yon par sna tshogs rin chen/ dpung pa g.yas par sna tshogs pad+ma/ g.yon pa sna tshogs las ma/ spyi bor nam mkha'i rdo rje ma/ rkang mthil gnyis la sa 'dzin lha mo/ rang gi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po dbus ma oṃ yis mtshan pa/ lha mo'i bha ga āḥlas pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po 'od zer lnga yis khyab pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa phan tshun rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro bas 'khyud pa dang 'o bya ba gzhibs pas yi ge hūm̐ glur len cing las la gnas par byas te 'byin pa'i skabs su phaṭḥ ces brjod/ lha rnams mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bas rtsa ba'i bu ga nas thig le'i gzugs kyis pad+ma'i dbus su babs pa mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sum cu rtsa gnyis su gyur nas phyir 'thon/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ khyad par rang rang gi gdul bya'i skal ba bzhin du sbyangs nas/ mchog tu dga' ba'i sku can rang rang gi zhing du bzhugs/ slar yang 'byon par bzhed pa rnams/ slob ma dbang bskur sbyin pa'i ched du/ gus pas rgyal ba de dag slar 'byon par bskul ba/ bdag nyid kyi snying gar ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje phra mo/ de'i lte bar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i yi ge hūm̐/ bdag nyid sems dpa' gsum du gyur pa las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa lta bu byung nas sems dpa' gsum bkug nas phyogs bcu'i zhing du bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la bkod pas thugs bskul te spyan drangs nas nam mkhar gnas pa la/
