khams kyi snying po gcig bu ma rungs bdud// rab tu bcom zhing 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// ting 'dzin mngon sum mdzad pa rang bzhin ni// 'gro ba mtha' yas rang bzhin kun gshegs shig /rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas se gol gtogs shing*/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ (slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sgrub mchod sogs kyi skabs sta gon gyi lha bstim pa 'di nyin dang por ma gtogs mi dgos/) zhes dkyil 'khor la so sor zhugs pa gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo in+d+ra ni li'i mdog can zhe sdang rdo rje mthing dmar dkar ba'i bzhugs pa/ shar gyi ling tsher zla ba rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ lhor zla ba la rin chen tog ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na nor bu/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ nub tu zla ba la mtha' yas rdo rje can dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum gyi dang pos pad+ma kha 'byed pa/ lhag mas rdo rje dang*/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu dang bcas pa'i pad dmar/ rin chen/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ byang du zla ba la don yod rdo rje can ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na ral gri/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ pad ljang*/ nor bu/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ ling tshe mer zla ba la spyan ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/

rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ srin por zla ba la mā ma kī nag mo nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje rtse dgu/ 'khor lo/ ut+pal sngon po/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ rlung du zla ba la gos dkar dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum gyi dang pos ut+pal kha 'byed pa dang*/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu dang bcas par ut+pal dmar po/ rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/ dbang ldan du zla ba la sgrol ma ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ ut+pal sngo ser/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i mer zla ba la gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis me long*/ lhag ma'i g.yas rdo rje dang*/ ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis rin chen/ ral gri/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ srin por zla ba la sgra rdo rje ma ser mo ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis pi wang brdung ba/ lhag ma'i g.yas 'khor lo ut+pal sngon po/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis rin chen/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ rlung du zla ba la dri rdo rje ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis dri'i dung chos/ lhag ma'i g.yas rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/ dbang ldan du zla ba la ro rdo rje ma ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis ro bcud kyi snod/ lhag ma'i g.yas 'khor lo/ ut+pal dmar po/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis rin chen/ ral gri/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ rim pa gsum pa'i lha snam nang ma'i shar du zla ba la byams pa dang sa snying dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi byams pa'i g.yas dang po klu shing gi me tog

sa snying gi g.yas dang po 'khor lo/ lhag mas g.yas rdo rje/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ lha snam nang ma'i lhor zla ba la phyag rdor dang nam snying ser po/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na/ nor bu/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa/ lha snam nang ma'i nub tu zla ba la 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'jam dbyangs dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum gyi dang pos pad+ma kha 'byed pa/ lhag mas rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu dang bcas pa'i pad dmar/ rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/ lha snam nang ma'i byang du zla ba la sgrib sel dang kun bzang ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na ral gri/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ pad ljang*/ nor bu/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ de dag thams cad zhi ba rin po che dang dar gyis klubs pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gi 'od zer 'phreng ba'i klong na bzhugs par/ shar sgor gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub/ dril bu/ dgra s+t+wa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ lho sgor shes rab mthar byed dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ dbyug pa/ ral gri/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub/ dril bu/ dgra s+t+wa/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa/ nub sgor pad+ma mthar byed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na pad+ma/ ral gri/ gtun shing*/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ dgra s+t+wa/ zhags pa/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan pa/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed sngon po/

sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ gtun shing*/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub/ dril bu/ dgra s+t+wa/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba mthing nag mthing dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na ral gri/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub/ dgra s+t+wa/ zhags pa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ lho nub tu 'dod pa'i rgyal po mthing nag mthing dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje/ ral gri/ g.yon gnyis zhags pa/ lcags kyu/ rin 'byung gi dbu brgyan pa/ nub byang du dbyug pa sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa/ pad+ma/ dgra s+t+wa/ 'od dpag mes pas dbu brgyan pa/ byang shar du stobs po che nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa/ rtse gsum/ dgra s+t+wa/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gtsug tor spyi bor 'dzin pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis sdigs mdzub dang*/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin chen/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ de thams cad kyang shin tu khros pa'i zhal gdangs shing drag po'i gad rgyangs can/ mche ba gtsigs pa spyan dmar po gsum gzir zhing*/ sma ra ag tshom mer 'bar ba/
sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ yan lag rags pa/ dpal gyi chas kyis brgyan te zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas me'i phung po'i nang du pad nyi la bzhugs pa/

de nas/ spyi bo'i dbus su zla ba oṃ dkar po 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba las byung ba'i spyan ma rnam par snang mdzad dang sbyor ba nam mkha' gang ba'i dbus kyi gtso bo'i mdun du bdag nyid gnas nas/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// rdo rje'i sku ni mdzad du gsol// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// rdo rje skur ni mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas lha'i tshogs de thams cad rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro bas mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong nas 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par zhu ba bdag gi rnam snang gi sgo nas zhugs te lus thams cad gang bas skus byin gyis brlabs/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang yin// phung po lnga yis rab gang bas// sangs rgyas sku yi ngo bo yi// bdag kyang de dang 'dra bar shog oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po 'od zer lnga rab tu 'phro ba las byung ba'i gos dkar mo 'od dpag med dang sbyor ba nam mkha' gang ba'i dbus kyi gtso bo'i mdun du bdag nyid 'dug nas/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal dang ldan/ rdo rjer= deng bdag= /rdo'i gsung du= phyogs= rdo rje= deng bdag= rdo rje'i gsung du= zhes gsol ba btab pas lha'i tshogs de dag thams cad rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong nas 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par zhu ba bdag gi zhal nas zhugs te lus thams cad gang bas gsung gi byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang yin// nges pa'i tshig ni phun sums tshogs// bdag gi tshig kyang de 'dra zhing*// chos 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāk+ka badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer lnga rab tu 'phro ba las byung ba'i mā ma kī mi bskyod pa dang sbyor ba/ nam mkha' gang ba'i dbus kyi gtso bo'i mdun du bdag nyid 'dug nas/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'chang ba/ rdo rje mi phyed= deng bdag= rdo rje'i thugs su= phyogs bcur= rdo rje mi phyed= deng bdag= rdo rje'i thugs su mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas lha'i tshogs de dag thams cad rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong nas 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par bdag gi thugs kar zhugs te lus thams cad gang bas thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs// kun tu bzang po'i thugs gang yin// gsang ba'i bdag po'i blo ldan pa// bdag kyang de dang 'dra gyur te// rdo rje 'dzin dang mtshungs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas rdo rje gsum mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ snying kha'i sa bon las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa thogs pa rnams kyis mchod par mos la/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i// sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gi dad pa 'bul lugs kyis// bzhes nas bdag la bka' drin mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ mchod yon dang*/ ar+ghaṃ zhes pa'i mal du/ zhabs bsil= pād+yaṃ= zhal bsil= āñca mā naṃ= bsang gtor= prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= rim par gzhug de ltar chu bzhi'i mchod pa phul nas/ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gis// rdo rje nyi ma pad+mar byung*// me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa// rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig mchog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

rnam rtog tshogs kyi yul min cing*// lte bar gtum mo'i me yis ni// nges par sreg pa de ni spos// thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhu pe= yi ge hūm̐ las yang dag byung*// sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal// mar me 'bar ba yang dag 'od// thugs kyi rdo rje= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā lo ke= bde ba chen po'i gzhi la gnas// byang chub sems ni sad pa dang*// de nyid kyis kyang byug pa dag /thugs kyi rdo rje= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dhe= 'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod// dang po thams cad yang dag brten// de dag thams cad thugs rje che// de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje// bza' ba'i snod du mchod par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nai wi d+ya= rdo rje pad+ma yang dag sbyar// zhugs pa la sogs rim las byung*// rnal 'byor pa yi mi shigs sgra// thugs kyi rdo rje= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shap+ta= zhes bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las gsungs pa'i nang gi nyer spyod rol mor bcas pa'o// thugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas// mchod par byed pas mchod par bya// de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa// sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gzhi// rū pa= sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas// lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa// sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas gtso// shap+ta= dri la rnam gsum= sangs rgyas sogs la dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa// 'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso// gan+dhe= ro la rnam gsum= lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa// sangs rgyas thogs med rdo rje 'dzin// ra sa= reg la rnam gsum= bdag gi rigs la dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can// mi bskyod pa yi tshul brnyes pa'o// spar+she= ces rtsa rgyud las byung ba phyi yi 'dod yon lnga gtso bor byas pa dang*/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyes la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ra sarba pū dza me gha sa mud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes gos zung 'bul/ phyag rgya'i rnam pa sngon po sogs// de bzhin gzugs la dbye ba gsum// gzugs kyi rdo rje mar bkug nas// sa snying la ni dbul bar bya// rū pa= yang dag glu dang brjod bral dbyangs// de bzhin sgra la dbye ba gsum// sgra yi rdo rje mar bkug nas// phyag rdor la ni dbul bar bya// shap+ta= ga bur a gar dzā ti sogs// de bzhin dri la dbye ba gsum// dri yi rdo rje mar bkug nas// nam snying la ni dbul bar bya// gan+dhe= 'o byed de bzhin 'jib pa dang*// ro drug de bzhin dbye ba gsum// ro yi rdo rje mar bkug nas// 'jig rten dbang phyug la ni dbul// ra sa= rdo rje pad+ma yang dag sbyor// 'khyud dang gos sogs dbye ba gsum// reg bya'i rdo rje mar bkug nas// sgrib sel la ni dbul bar bya// spar+she/ phyi yi chos rnams 'di dag kun// brtags pa dang ni ma brtags pa// chos dbyings rdo rjer yang dag bkug /'jam pa'i rdo rje la ni dbul// dharma dhā tu= zhes rdor phreng las gsungs pa'i nang gi 'dod yon lngas mchod/ pad+ma rā ga in+d+ra nī la dang*// baiḍūr+ya dang ma ra ta ka mchog /rdo rje mu tig byi ru dang bcas pa'i// rin chen sna bdun 'jig rten gang bas mchod// sap+ta rat+na/ zhes rin chen bdun dang*/ 'dzam bu'i gser las rang byung lte ba zlum// rtsibs stong mu khyud mchog tu rnam 'phrul ba// mkha' la rab 'phags phyogs las rgyal byed pa'i// 'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// oṃ tsakra rat+na pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ thal dkar mche ba drug pa zla 'od can// chu zheng phun tshogs yud kyis mkha' lam nas// sa chen rgya mtsho'i ska rags can bskor ba'i// glang po rin chen= oṃ hasti rat+na sogs gong bzhin/ spu kha rma bya'i mgrin 'dra yid 'ong zhing*// gser gyi rgyan ldan mgyogs pa yid lta bus// tho rangs sa rnams bskor te slar ldog pa'i// rta mchog rin chen=

oṃ ā shwa rat+na= kun tu sngo ba snang byed bai ḍūr+ya// nyin mor byed pa 'od kyis rnam gnon cing*// bsam pa rdzogs byed legs sbyangs cha brgyad pa// nor bu rin chen= oṃ ma ṇi rat+na= 'chi med bu mo bzhin du gzugs mdzes shing*// reg bya mchog gis lus sems bde byed pa// sgyu rtsal kun shes smra mkhas dri bzang gter// btsun mo rin chen= oṃ s+t+rī rat+na= phur bu'i blo ldan mdzangs shing yid gzhungs pa// khor yug gter gyi 'dod dgur 'dzud byed cing*// nges pa snyan pa'i tshig 'byin lha mig can// khyim bdag rin chen= oṃ pu ru ṣa rat+na= sred med bu yi stobs ldan dpa' ba dang*// rtul phod yid la rgyus pa'i don rnams kun// mod la sgrub cing phas rgol med byed pa// blon po rin chen= oṃ khaḍ+ga rat+na= 'od zer gyis sngo ral gri pags pa 'jam// dga' ba'i nags tshal gos ni yid rjes 'gro// mthu ldan mchil lahwam khang khyim gzhal med du// reg 'jam gzims cha nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// oṃ u pa rat+na pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod do// de nas bstod pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// sogs de nyid lnga pa dang*/ gnyis med rnam rgyal las 'byung ba/ mo ha ra ti'i sngags las skyes// sa yi khams ni rnam dag cing*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum gyur pa// lha mo spyan mar phyag 'tshal lo// dwe ṣa ra ti'i sngags las skyes// chu yi khams ni rnam dag cing*// rdo rje rigs kyi yum gyur pa// mā ma kī la phyag 'tshal lo// rā ga ra ti'i sngags las skyes// me yi khams ni rnam dag cing*// pad+ma'i rigs kyi yum gyur pa// gos dkar mo la phyag 'tshal lo// badz+ra ra ti'i sngags las skyes// rlung gi khams ni rnam dag cing*// las kyi rigs kyi yum gyur pa// sna tshogs sgrol mar phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems chen po// rtsa rgyus khams ni dag pa'i sku// nyon mongs rnam dag byams pa ni// rgyal ba rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems chen po// mig gi skye mched spyod mdzad pa// sa yi snying po de bzhin gshegs// sku yi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' chen po ni// sna yi skye mched rnam dag pa// phyag na rdo rje mthu stobs can// thugs kyi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' chen po ni// sna yi skye mched sbyangs gyur pa// nam mkha'i snying po mchog gyur pa'i// ting 'dzin rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' chen po ni// lce yi skye mched dag byed pa// 'jig rten dbang phyug bla na med// gsung gi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba che// yid kyi skye mched rnam dag cing*// dag pa'i sems mchog 'jam dbyangs sku// nam mkha'i rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' theg pa che// lus kyi skye mched dag pa po// sgrib pa thams cad sel bar mdzad// dam tshig rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' rgyal dbang po// 'gro ba'i sems rgyud sbyong mdzad pa// kun tu bzang po ye shes rol// chos dbyings rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje gzugs ni yid du 'ong*// snang stong kun tu rol pa yi// chos rnams sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul ston// gzugs kyi lha mor phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje sgra ni yid du 'ong*// sgra dang sgra min las grol ba// stong nyid rang sgra 'byung ba po// sgra yi lha mor phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje ro yi lha mor phyag 'tshal lo// ya mān+ta kṛta sngags las skyes// sku yi gsang ba khro bo che// dbang po mnan zhing shar phyogs bzhugs// gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// pra dz+nyān+ta kṛta sngags las skyes// thugs las skyes pa'i khro bo ni// gshin rje mnan zhing lho phyogs bzhugs// rnam par rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// pad+mān+ta kṛta sngags las skyes// gsung mchog pad+mar rang byung ba// chu bdag mnan zhing nub phyogs bzhugs// rta mchog rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// bigh+nān+ta kṛta sngags las skyes// phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa po// gnod sbyin mnan zhing byang phyogs bzhugs// bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par rtog pas mi g.yo zhing*// ye shes gsang ba'i don ldan pa// khro rgyal byin za'i steng bzhugs pa// mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// brtul zhugs chen po mi bzad pa// log 'dren dpung rnams 'joms mdzad pa// khro rgyal bden bral steng na bzhugs// 'dod pa'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo// gtum po srid gsum 'joms mdzad cing*// snying rje'i stobs dang ldan pa'i sku// rlung bdag steng gnas khro bo che// dbyug sngon can la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// ye shes mchog gis dbang bskur ba// khro rgyal dbang ldan steng bzhugs pa// stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rtog pa dag byas shing*// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i gar mdzad pa// tshangs pa'i steng bzhugs lha yi tshogs// 'khor los sgyur la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// spros med de bzhin nyid las byung*// kā la kro dha gnon mdzad pa// khro rgyal gnod mdzes phyag 'tshal lo//

ces dang*/ spros pas ma lcogs bsdu bar 'dod na/ zag bcas phung po gnas gyur cing*// nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku// kun mkhyen kun mdzad kun gyi gtso// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la 'dud// sa sogs 'byung ba rnam dag cing*// byams sogs tshad med ngo bo nyid// zag med bde ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa// lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrib med 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// phun tshogs bde ba skyed mdzad ma// lha mo lnga la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// phrin las 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing*// mi zad mngon shes yon tan ldan// sems dpa' brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams 'joms mdzad cing*// stobs bcu rnam par dag pa'i bdag /zhi sogs las kun sgrub mdzad pa'i// khro rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam dag cing*// byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin can// bde chen snying po legs rdzogs pa// gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yi// sa gzhi ra ba gur bla re// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba can// srung ba'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo// ces pas bstod/ de nas tha mal gang la'ang ma chags shing lha'i rnal 'byor dang mi phyed pa'i yid bzlas sam bskyed rim rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ dam tshig gi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal gdab pa gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa/ 'khor rnams la nyer gcig re thams cad kyi rten byed yi ge brgya pa mang du bzla'o// dkyus su bzlas pa mi gsal yang*/ khungs thub kyi gzhung dang*/ bla ma gong ma dag gi phyag bzhes las 'byung ba bzhin du'o// de nas nang mchod kyi bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las bdud rtsi'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud rnams/

shar du go las ba glang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bi las dri chen/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du ma las klad pa/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ shar du bh+rūm̐/ lhor āṃ/ nub tu dz+rīṃ/ byang du khaṃ/ dbus su hūm̐/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse dgu pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung gi ba dan la phog /rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa bsregs/ dag pa zhu zhing khol ba'i rlangs pa oṃ dang hūm̐ la phog oṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa thod par lhung ba'i rlangs pa dang*/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur/ rdo rje zla ba oṃ dang bcas pa thod par lhung ste/ zhu nas dam tshig gi bdud rtsir 'dres pa/ hūm̐ gis sbyangs/ yi ge āḥs rtogs par byas/ oṃ gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bsnan pas sbyar ba kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/

lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ mchod do phud thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rigs thams cad kyi dbang phyug /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rtsa brgyud kyi rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du pañca a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+rik hūm̐ hūm̐/ pañca a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ āḥdzi na dz-ik oṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥrat+na dh+rik swā hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥ.a ro l̥k āḥhūm̐/ pañca= oṃ ā pradz+nyā dhṛk hā hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥmo ha ra ti laṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ra ti maṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥrā ga ra ti pāṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥbadz+ra ra ti tāṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra dzaḥhūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥshap+ta badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥgan+dha badz+ra baṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥr sa badz+ra hoḥhūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥspar+she badz+ra khaṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥmai tri meṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥk+ṣi ti gar+bha thiṃl hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥbadz+ra pā ṇi oṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥkha gar+bha oṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥlo ke shwa ra oṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥmañju shrī hūm̐ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥsarba ni wa ra ṇa biskaṃ bhi ni oṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥs man+ta bhā dra saṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta huṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥpradz+nyān+ta kṛta huṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥpad+man+ta kṛta huṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥbighan+ta kṛta huṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥ.a tsa la huṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥṭak+ki rā dza huṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥni la daṇ+ḍa huṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥm hā bā la huṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥ.uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti huṃ hūm̐/ pañca= oṃ āḥsum+bha ra dza huṃ hūm̐/ pañca a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du pañca a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/

gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du pañca a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ dpal ma hā kā la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ dug gsum gyi sman pa/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma chen po bya rog ming can 'khor bka' sdod dang bcas pa la sogs pa dam pa chos skyong ba ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du pañca a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ zhan yang yul phyogs 'di nyid na gnas pa la sogs lha ma srin sde brgyad/ 'gro ba rigs drug /skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi zhal du pañca a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ zhes phul ba'o// de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa bya ste/ tshogs rdzas rnams bdud rtsi ril bu btab nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang gis bsangs gtor byas la/ de nas lag pa g.yon bkab/ oṃ yig gis sbyang bar bya'o// lag pa g.yas bkab/ āḥyig gis rtogs par bya'o// snyim pa bkab ste/ hūm̐ yig gis sbar bar bya'o// mkha' lding gi phyag rgya dang*/ hoḥyig gis bdud rtsir bya zhing*/ hūm̐ dbyings srid zhi kun tu 'char ba'i ma// sogs kyis byin gyis brlab/ hūm̐/ thugs zung 'jug rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// sogs kyis spyan drangs nas/ tshogs phud dang po/ hūm̐/ rje srid zhi'i phan pa thams cad du// sogs kyis phul/ tshogs phud gnyis pa/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛk hūm̐ hūm̐/ gha na tsakra pū dza khā hi/ sogs nas/ oṃ āḥsum+bha rā dza hum̐ hūm̐/ gha na tsakra pū dza khā hi/ bar gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la 'bul/ tshogs phud gsum pa/ hūm̐/ zhi ba dang khro chags thams cad pa// sogs kyis phul/ tshogs phud bzhi pa/ hūm̐/ 'khor 'das kyi ngo mtshar ma lus pa// sogs kyis phul/ tshogs phud lnga pa/ hūm̐/ bdud tshogs dang bdud la chos par gnyen//

sogs kyis phul/ bsod nams 'di yis sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes thob par gyur cig/ ces brjod la/ nang gi sbyin sreg byas/ de nas phyi rol du 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ sgrub grogs dkyil 'khor bsrung bar bzhag nas phyi rol tu gtor ma bsham la/ gtor ma hūm̐ gis sbyangs/ yi ge āḥs rtogs par byas/ oṃ gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bsnan pas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsir gyur/ zhes kha zas bzhin sbyangs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas/ oṃ da sha dig bh+yaḥ s+thi ti bh+yaḥ i ha a ba s+thi ti bh+yaḥ tsa de wa nā ga yak+ṣa/ gan+dharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin+ni ra/ ma ho ra ga bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ un+man+ta/ a pasma ra/ osta ra ga a ti/ bh+yo ba li tāṃ pa ya/ mi gṛ hī twā su kha sau ma na s+ye lā/ bi no bha wan+tu s+thā nī/ tsa ni ru pa dra/ kurban+tu/ sarba bud+dha a dhi ni na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ i daṃ a mṛ ta biṇ+ḍi bhu ka to ma ma sa pa ri wā ri shin+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis ye shes sems dpa'i phyi 'brang gi phyogs skyong la sogs pa rnams la 'bul/ oṃ phyogs bcur rnam par gnas rnams dang*// 'dir ni kun tu gnas pa dang*// lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*// dri za lha min nam mkha' lding*// mi'am ci dang lto 'phye che// 'byung po yi dwags sha za dang*// smyo byed dang ni rjed byed dang*// gnon po la sogs pa rnams la// gtor ma 'bul gyis bsnams nas kyang*// bde dang yid bde thob gyur cig /gnas 'dir nyer 'tshe med par mdzod// sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs kyis// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bdud rtsi yi// bza' ba la ni longs spyad nas// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swā hā/ zhing skyong la sogs 'byung po'i tshogs// srid pa gsum na gang gnas pa// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la//

sogs nas/ dgra rnams thams cad pham par mdzad// bar gyis 'dod don gsol/ de nas bum pa las sngags kyis bsangs/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sgom/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las rin po che'i bum pa/ sogs nas/ bgegs rnams srung bar mdzad du gsol// zhes pa'i bar sngar sta gon gyi skabs bzhin bum chog bya/ bcu gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal du gnas pa langs nas/ nub phyogs kyi sgor gnas te g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis rol zhing rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ut+ga ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ de bzhin byang phyogs su gnas nas lho/ shar nas nub/ lho nas byang*/ sgo tshul de gnyis kyis dbye bar bya'o// de nas slob ma bzhugs pa'i phyir bden pa'i byin brlab bya ba ni/ rang bzhin 'od gsal las byung ba'i// rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che// gzugs brnyan dang yang 'dra ba nyid// dkyil 'khor yang ni de dang 'dra// de nas gzhug pa'i don du gsol ba btab pa ni/ 'di de rdo rje snying po yis// rdo rje ye shes sgrub byed pa// de bzhin gshegs kun pho brang du// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// zhugs pa de bzhin gshegs rnams kyi// chos kyi dbyings kyis byin rlabs dang*// dam tshig kyang ni spros pa las// phun sum tshogs kun stsal du gsol//bden bskul dang gsol ba btab pa 'di gnyis/ dbang gi skabs bdag 'jug gi gsham du mdzad pa phyag len no// slob ma shar sgor yol ba'i phyir bcug nas dbang bskur ba'i rim pa la 'jug par bya ba yin la/ de'i gong du 'dir bdag nyid 'jug pa'i rim pa ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas las thams cad pas chus khrus byas/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa sogs maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang tha mi dad pa'i drung du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa zhu ba'i yon du

sogs/ ta ya mi/ zhes phul/ oṃ tsak+ṣur ban+dha ba ra mā na ya hūm̐/ oṃ pra bi sha bha ga wān mahā su kha mok+ṣa pu raṃ sarba sid+dhi su kha pa ri pa ra ma su kha ut+ta ma sidh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pra sid+dh+ya swā hā/ zhes pas mig dar bcings/ kye dga' ba la dga' ba khyod su/ zhes dri/ slob mas/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags/ zhes lan gdab/ slob ma mnyam par 'dug cing thal mo sbyar bas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// zhes pas sh+lau ka lan gsum gyis sems bskyed sbyin/ de nas slob ma des mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi tshogs la dmigs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pa s+thā nā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa twa adhi tiṣ+ṭha māṃ/ zhes phyag bya/ de nas rin chen 'byung gnas kyi tshogs la dmigs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā gā ta pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣañca māṃ/ de nas 'od dpag med kyi tshogs la dmigs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā gā ta pū dza pra warta na ya at+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharmā pra warta ya māṃ/ de nas don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi tshogs la dmigs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma ṇe āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru māṃ/ zhes pa'i phyag byas shar khyams su bzhag nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su bzhugs kyis/ de'i phyir ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya yis ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra ba mi bya'o// khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs pa rtser me tog bzung du bcug pa'o// slar bla mas phyag rgya de spyi bor bzhag nas so//

'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la smras na spyi bo 'gems par byed do// zhes dang*/ slar yang de snying khar bkod nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes brjod/ rdo rje'i chu oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsngags pa 'thung du bcug la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭhaḥ slob ma'i lag pa nas gzung ste/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi rdo rje sems dpa' nga yin gyis ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba de khyod bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig khyod mi bde ba ma spangs bar tshe yi dus byas na sems can dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes dam la bzhag go /de nas ye shes dbab pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /rdo rje sems dpa' dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ slob ma'am/ bdag nyid kyi lus khong stong du song ba'i 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du yi ge dzhaiṃḥdamar po rlung gis me dang sa bon spar ba'i 'od zer gyis lus thams cad bsregs te 'od gsal du zhugs pa la mnyam par bzhag /de las ldang ba'i phyir slob ma'i snying mgrin mgo bo la hūm̐ a ha gsal btab/ sngar gyi sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya snying khar bzhag 'di khyod dam tshig rdo rje ste// rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba// rdo rje ye shes bla na med// de ni khyod la 'bebs par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya aḥ.aḥ gal te ma babs na/ āḥlas 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pas ye shes chen po bskul bar bsam zhing*/ ā be sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/

ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya tsā la ya hūm̐ ha aḥdzhaiṃ/ zhes pas snying 'dar dga' ba che ba dang sogs babs pa'i mtshan ma ste/ lce la a yig bsam/ yi ge brgya pas brtag bya'o// de nas me tog gi phreng ba tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha wa hṛ da yaṃ me a dhi t-iṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ.oṃ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐ pra tīts+tsha ku su maṃ mañja li nā tha hoḥ zhes dkyil 'khor du me tog dor gang la babs pa de de'i rigs kyi lhar dang babs pas dngos grub ci 'grub pa'i brda sprad/ slob ma'i mig gnyis su oṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyis// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// de ring dad pa'i shugs kyis ni// dkyil 'khor 'di la blta bar bgyi// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skye// sangs rgyas chen po byin gyis brlabs// he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ 'phags pa'i bden bzhi ngos bzhir 'gyur// tshangs pa'i gnas ni grwa yin no// bsdu ba'i dngos po zhes bya sgo// bzhi yi ming can re re ste// dad pa'i dbang po la sogs sems// rnam pa lnga po yang dag 'byung*// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa sgo khyud ni// bzhi ste de yang rnam pa bzhi// de yi dbus kyi 'khor lo gang*// dkyil 'khor brgyad kyis gzhal ba ni// rnam par thar pa brgyad yin te// dngos grub thams cad sgrub byed pa'o// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad pa ni// ka ba brgyad ces bya bar bshad// sangs rgyas kun gyi khang chen du// thams cad tshe na ka bar 'gyur// chos dang de nyid don gyi brda// 'khor lo'i nang gi dkyil 'khor ro// thugs kyi dkyil 'khor 'di de ni// thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog/ ces rten dang*/ phung po lnga yi rang bzhin du// sangs rgyas lnga rnams rab brtan bya// spyan ma la sogs lha mo bzhi// sa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin no// de ni 'dod yon lnga'i ngo bor// gzugs rdo rje la sogs pa'o// mig la sogs pa'i rang bzhin du// sa yi snying po la sogs so// lag sogs ngo bor khro dbang po// gshin rje'i dgra sogs brten par bya//

zhes pa lha'i ngo bor bstan no// bcu gsum pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar raṃ byang du khrus kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa dkar dmar nag pa'i rwa ba rim pa gsum dang ldan pa 'phar ma gnyis/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan nag lte ba ljang*/ phyogs bzhi'i shar rdo rje/ lhor rin chen/ nub pad mar/ byang ral gri bkod pa la der bum pa rnams bkod/ mchod/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bsrungs la bzhag go /bcu bzhi pa ni/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyobs pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol//

lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ las bum kyis bsangs/ oṃ shū n+ya ta sa sbyangs/ bdag nyid mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis sku rdo rje sku mdog dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na/ 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na/ dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la rin po che'i prog zhu dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa gsal bar gyur/ de nas sngar dor ba'i me tog gi phreng ba de dkyil 'khor gyi lha me tog phogs zhes slob ma'i mgor/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa i maṃ satwaṃ ma hā pa la zhes pas bcings par mos pa phreng ba'i dbang ngo*// khrus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag ste/ bum pa rnams kyi chu rnam rgyal du bsdus la/ bum pa las sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje rtse dgu/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ bsgoms pa ji lta ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ mi bskyod pa 'od du zhu ba las dbang rdzas kyi bum pa'i chur gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gdan gsum lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi lnga'i chus gang bas dbang bskur bar bsam/ til gyi gang bu ltar gang ba'i// rgyal ba bum pa 'dzin rnams kyis// de ring khyod la dbang bskur gyis// de ltar shes nas yid bder gyis// dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣiñca mi sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti twe no pa dri ḍho bha wa/

zhes dbang bskur la bum chu gtor bzhin/ rdo rje'i rigs mchog bdag po kun gyi bdag nyid can// 'gro ba ma lus bskyed par mdzad cing bde ba che// 'gro ba mtha' dag snying la zhugs pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis de ni deng du dbang bskur mchog tshe khyod la shog /mgon po mi bskyod pa zhes bya ba mtshan 'dzin pa// skye tshogs zhe sdang zil gyis mnan pa spyod mdzad cing*// rdo rje rigs mtha' dag dang ldan pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis de ni= rnam par snang mdzad rtag tu srid pa'i sdug bsngal sel// skye tshogs gti mug gis zil mnan pa spyod mdzad cing*// 'khor lo'i rigs mtha' dag dang ldan pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis de ni/ dbul ba'i sdugabasngal las ni yongs su thar lhur len// skye tshogs nga rgyal gyis zil gnon mdzad cing*// rin chen rigs mtha' dag dang ldan pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis de ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug srid pa'i gzeb ni 'joms mdzad pa// skye tshogs 'dod chags kyis zil mnan pa sbyongs mdzad cing*// pad+ma'i rigs mtha' dag dang ldan pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis de ni/ rdzun smra dga' ba rnams la brtse ba'i bdag nyid can// de sbyongs thabs gsungs pa yis de dag mi bslu ba// las kyi rigs mtha' dag dang ldan pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis de ni deng dus dbang bskur mchog tshe khyod la shog/ ces shis pa brjod la/ ched du brjod pa'i tshul gyis/ rdo rje khyed dang sangs rgyas ni// rnams kyis dbang bskur bas dbang bskur// oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ zhes chus khrus bya/ de ltar mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang gi dri ma dag rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa la dbang ba yin no// chu'i dbang ngo*/ /de nas khrus kyi dkyil 'khor nas phyung ste dkyil 'khor chen po'i ngos nas rgyan dang gos dmar blangs te rgyal po'i rgyan gyis brgyan/

gdugs dkar po steng du phub nas glu 'di brjod de/ bde ba chen po chags pa che// rdo rje chen po nor bu che// shes rab chen po dga' ba che// rdo rje sems bdag deng 'grub shog /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor lo che// dngos grub kun gyi bde ba stsol// dbang bskur thams cad don thams cad// rdo rje dbang bskur bla na med// dang po'i sangs rgyas don dam mnga' ba rgyal gyur cig /'dod khar nor dang chos gsol mdzad pa rgyal gyur cig /ye shes lnga yi rab dga'i bde chen rgyal gyur cig /mgon po phyag na rdo rje bde chen rgyal gyur cig/ de nas bla ma dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas shar sgor 'bol ba'i stan la slob ma bzhag nas 'khod pa la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ nas/ nai wi d+ya bar gyi mchod pa lnga byas te/ dbu rgyan bsangs sbyangs/ dbu rgyan mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las swā las rin po che swā yis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas nor bu rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu pad ser ral gri 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros bsgom pa ji lta ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ rin 'byung 'od du zhu ba dbang rdzas dbu rgyan rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin du gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gdan gsum lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis rin po che'i cod pan dar dpyangs dang bcas pas dbang bskur bar bsam la/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba mthe bong gnyis dkyil du bskum/ gong mo gnyis gshibs/ de'i phyir bar tshigs mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse btsugs pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang mo'i phyag rgya bkod nas/

oṃ badz+ra dhā tī shwa raṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ mi bskyod pa/ sngar gyi rdo rje'i ma'i phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag nas/ oṃ satwa badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca bh+rūṃ/ rnam snang*/ rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya las gung mo'i tshigs dbus ma bcag pa rin chen rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya de des rna ltag g.yas par/ oṃ rat+na badz+ri a bhi ṣiñca aḥ rin 'byung*/ de nyid las gung mo pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa rdo rje chos ma'i phyag rgya ste des ltag par/ oṃ dharma badz+ri a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ 'od dpag med/ de nyid las dbus ma'i rtse mo bcag pa las kyi rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya ste des rna ltag g.yon par/ oṃ karma badz+ri a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ don grub/ me tog gang phog rigs kyi bdag po dang mi bskyod pa de'i gnas su bskor ba bya'o// de nas dbu rgyan la btags pa'i dar dpyangs rna ltag g.yon du bcangs nas mnyam pa'i thal mos oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥ zhes mnyes par byas la cod pan bskon/ de ltar rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa'i dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma sbyangs/ tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du byas/ rin 'byung dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang ba yin no// cod pan gyi dbang ngo*/ rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ /rdo rje mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas pad+ma ās mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las 'od dpag med dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pad+ma rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu dang bcas pa'i pad dmar/ rin chen/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar sa bon las 'od 'phros bsgom pa ji lta ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ 'od dpag med 'od du zhu ba dbang rdzas kyi rdo rje snang mtha'i rang bzhin du gyur/

dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gdan gsum lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis rdo rjes dbang bskur bar bsam la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dngos grub mchog phyir rdo rje long*// sangs rgyas kun gyi khyod la stsol// rdo rje brtul zhugs grub par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti twaṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya/ de nas 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// de nas slob mas lha'i snyems pas rdo rje sems dpa' nga rgyal gyi ngag tu/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba ste// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje sems dpa' bdag po'i mchog/ rdo rje snying khar bzhag nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dhā ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hrīḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ de ltar 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang ba yin no// rdo rje'i dbang ngo*// dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ dril bu mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hā las ral gri has mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las don yod grub pa ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu pad ljang nor bu 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ bsgom pa ji lta ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ don grub 'od du zhu ba dbang rdzas kyi dril bu don grub kyi rang bzhin du gyur/

dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gdan gsum lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis dril bus dbang bskur bar bsam la/ dril bu gtad la des dkrol la zhing tshigs su bcad pa 'di 'don no// zla 'dra'i ye shes sku mnga' rgyal rnams cod pan 'dzin cing pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs// gdug pa rnams ni 'dul bar bya phyir bsdigs shing khams gsum 'dul mdzad de nyid rdo rje can// sangs rgyas rnams sad bya phyir sgra brnyan de bzhin nyid dang chos 'di sgrog pa'i dril bu can// gang la lus pa med pa gtong zhing bcom ldan dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin de ni rgyal// me long gi ni gzugs brnyan dang*// rmi lam sgyu ma chu bur dang*// mig 'phrul bar ni sus mthong ba// de ni mnga' bdag tu bshad do// slar sku'i phyogs su khyer nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rol pa'i// rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya 'don// bcom ldan khyod kyis gzung gyur gyis// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes brjod/ de ltar don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog gi dri ma dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don grub dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub rnams bsgrub pa la dbang ba yin no// dril bu'i dbang ngo*// de nas gser ram dngul snod du gnas pa'i mig sman mig thur gyis blangs te/ de kho na nyid shes pas mig la byugs te/ oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// de nas me long a sa mngon par bsngags pa rdo rje bcas pa bstan te/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las la kun tu byung*/ ngo bo med cing gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang rgyal ba'i thugs las skyes//

zhes me long gi dbang ngo*// slob ma bsang sbyangs/ bdag nyid mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ pad+ma dkar po/ g.yon dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ de nas slob dpon dbyibs dang ngo bo mchog gi sprul pa'i sku gzhan lung ston pa'i gnas skabs ji ltar gyur pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gdan gsum lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gsung gcig pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad thabs cig pas// srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton nas// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// bdag 'dis khyod lung bstan par bya// theg pa bde chen 'di las ni// khyed la slar yang 'chi ba med// de ring bdud rnams pham byas nas// grong khyer dam par rab tu zhugs// deng du khyed kyi sangs rgyas nyid// thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// oṃ badz+ra satwa trāṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ badz+ra nā maḥ rigs dang mthun pa'i ming rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin du bsgoms la btags/ /abhi ṣe ka ta/ shrī a nu rak+to badz+ra ta thā ga ta sa ma ya sid+dh+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhūr bhu baḥswaḥ.āḥ de ltar rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug gi dri ma dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam snang dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang ba yin no// ming gi dbang ngo*// bco lnga pa ni/

de nas 'khor lo sogs gtad de/ sems can kun la phan don du// 'jig rten kun tu thams cad nas// gdul bya ji bzhin chos kyi ni// 'khor lo sna tshogs bskor ba gyis// dza ya dza ya sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti pra warta ya dharma tsakraṃ/ sems can kun la= 'jig rten kun tu= gdul bya ji bzhin 'dul ba yis// sangs rgyas rin chen rab tu ston// oṃ badz+ra rat+na sarba dharma bi shud+dha dz+nyā na a bhi ṣe ka prā bha oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sems can kun la= 'jig rten kun tu= gdul bya ji bzhin 'dod chags ni// spyod pa sna tshogs bstan par bgyi// oṃ badz+ra dharma sarba dharma bi shud+dha dz+nyā nā ra ga pad+ma da la swa bha wa hrīḥ.aḥ sems can kun la= 'jig rten kun tu= gdul bya ji bzhin rdo rje yis// spyod pa sna tshogs 'jug par bgyi// oṃ badz+ra karma sarba dharma bi shud+dha dz+nyā na sarba pū dza swa bha wa aḥ

de nas slob dpon gyis dam tshig bsgrag par bya ste/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya// rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya// ma byin par yang khyod kyis blangs// gzhan gyi chung ma bsten par bya// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni// nam yang dor bar mi bya'o// slob dpon brnyas par mi bya ste// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyam pas// slob dpon la ni gang brnyas pa// des ni sangs rgyas kun brnyas pas// rtag tu sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur// de phyir sangs rgyas 'bras 'dod cing*// gus dang ldan pa'i sems can gyis// bsam yas 'bras bu stsol ba po// 'di la 'bad pas kun gyis mchod// byang chub go 'phang bla'am ci// srid pa sel bar su yis nus// gang la skye shing 'chi ba med// gang zhig las gnyis la nus ldan// rdo rje slob dpon med par ni// nyon mongs thams cad spong ba dang*// mya ngan 'das zhi go 'phang dang*// phyir mi ldog pa thob mi 'gyur// rang gi dam tshig rtag tu bsgrub// rtag tu de bzhin gshegs rnams mchod// rtag tu bla ma la 'bul bya// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// thabs dang shes rab ldan sems kyis// mi bya ba ni gcig kyang med// rtag tu rnam rtog med gyur nas// khyed kyis 'dod pa lnga rnams spyod// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun gsungs shing*// bka' lung dam pa rtag pa yi// dam tshig dang ni sdom pa 'di// khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya// phyag mtshan gyi dbang ngo*// bcu drug pa ni/ lha'i grangs ji lta bas yon 'bul te/ oṃ a nut+tā ra sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga khaṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*// glu la sogs pa ste tshogs kyi 'khor los so// bcu bdun pa ni/ de nas yul dang yid 'ong chung ma nor lus longs spyod sogs blo yis blangs te/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod thams cad dang*// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus kun// skyes mchog khyed kyi 'bangs su 'bul lags na// thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes nas skyabs tu gsol//

zhes phul bas bla ma mnyes par bya'o// bco brgyad pa ni/ de ltar yon gyis bla ma yi dam mnyes pas slob ma la rjes su gnang ba'i phyir/ mchod pa kun gyis sngon mchod byin/ sangs rgyas kun gyi spyan snga ru// bsdad nas sdig pa kun spangs la// khyod la ngas deng 'phreng ba sogs// dbang bskur pa yi dbang bskur te// da khyod sngags dang rgyud 'dzin cing*// dkyil 'khor gyi ni slob dpon du// sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams dang*// lha rnams kyis kyang yang dag bzhed// khyed kyis de nyid bdud rnams pham// khyod kyis sangs rgyas thams cad bcom// yi ge'i spyod pa spyod bzhin du// khyod kyis sems can kun don gyis// ya nga ba ni rnams la yang*// chos rnams kun la ser sna dang*// sems can kun la mi phan gang*// de ni bu khyod kyis mi bya// ji lta ji ltar lam 'di la// som nyi za bar mi bya'o// sngags kyi spyod tshul dam pa ni// mtshungs med khyod kyis bstan par gyis// dkyil 'khor bri bar byas nas ni// slob ma yongs su bsdu bar gyis// dogs pa med pa'i sems kyi ni// slob ma la dbang bskur bar gyis// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das dngos grub// brtul zhugs brten pa khyod kyis bsgrubs// de nyid rtogs pa'i sems ldan pas// de dag thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// chos dbyings byin gyis brlab pa dang*// dam tshig rnams yongs bskyang ba las// rtag tu bla ma gus khyod la// las rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// de ltar byas pa shes pa ni// sangs rgyas la phan 'dogs zhes sgrogs// de phyir sangs rgyas kun mkhyen pas// khyod ni mngon par bsrung bar 'gyur// de nas slob mas lus btud cing thal mo snying khar sbyar nas bla ma la phyag byas la/ de kun de bzhin no// zhes zhu/ rjes su gnang ba'i dbang bskur ba'o// de ltar rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor lus dkyil dang lhan cig tu bum dbang yan lag dang bcas pa thun mong gi dbang dgu thob/

lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa yin no// de nas gshegs gsol dang*/ nyer bsdu sogs bsham du 'byung zhing*/ 'dir dbang gi sa bcad gnyis pa/ bsam gtan la sbyor ba'i slob dpon gyi bya ba gsang ba'i dbang dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gsang sngags tshul gnas rnal 'byor pa// gnyis med ye shes sbyor ldan pas// sgyu ma lta bu'i lus kyis ni// 'khor lo sgyu ma lta bu bri// zhes pa ste thams cad phyi rdul tshon lta bu bri mi dgos yid kyi dkyil 'khor du'o// mchog dbang la slob mas 'byor pa ji yod pas tshogs kyi yo byad/ lhag par legs par bslabs pa'i phyag rgya gzhon nu ma phul te/ slob dpon gyis tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor legs par bsgrub cing 'dod pa lnga la longs spyod pas mnyes pa/ der nam phyed kyi dus su/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod kyi bka' drin gang gis bdag /bdag dang gzhan don byed nus pa/ yang dag pa yi dbang bskur ni// snying rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol btab/ bla mas slob ma la snying rje chen po bskyed de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bcings/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje 'chang chen po dang*/ shes rab ma reg bya rdo rje ma'i ngo bor bzhugs pa/ yab yum mnyam par sbyor nas legs par snyoms par zhugs/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin thams cad spyan drangs/ gtso bo'i spyi bo nas thim thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ stong pa bzhi'i ye shes lhan cig skyes pa brtan par byas/ byang chub kyi sems dung chus su phyung te bdud rtsi lnga dang bsres pa de nyid/ slob ma bdag nyid gsung rdo rje dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pad+ma/

rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas pad dmar/ rin chen/ ral gri 'dzin/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan nas rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa gsal ba la/ pad+ma'i dbus na rin chen 'bar ba phyung nas ni// ma lus rgyal ba'i sku ni kun tu bskams pa la// rnam par dag pa'i rdo rje las byung ye shes chu// rin chen 'bar ba'i char gyis spyi bor dbang bskur ro// zhes bdud rtsi byin pa de nyid/ des kyang byang chub las mi g.yo ba'i bsam pas bza' ba dang rang gi lus la gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs tshim par bya'o zhes bsam nas/ a ho mahā su kha zhes myang ngo*// slar mchog tu gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ bla ma yab yum dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bzhugs pas yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po/ dbus ma oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lha mo'i bha ga āḥlas pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po 'od zer lnga yis khyab pa/ rdo rje pad+ma'i mtshams nas 'od zer spros te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis rang gi sku bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa rnams rang gi snying khar bsdus te sa bon gyi gzugs su rdo rje'i lam nas phyung la rdo rje nyid kyi slob ma'i khar dbab par bya ste/ kye ma rdo rje blang bar bya// de ni gsang ba zhes bya ste/ dbang bskur ba yi thabs mchog go /rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid che// zhes brjod/ slob ma rang gi khar babs pa'i byang chub kyi sems myangs pas bde ba chen po thob par bya'o// zhes btung ngo*/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar dbye/ de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas ngag gi dri ma dag lam rang lus thabs ldan gyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku mngon du gyur pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/

tho rangs la nye ba na/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod kyi bka' drin gang gis bdag /bdag dang gzhan don byed nus pa// shes rab ye shes dbang bskur ni// snying rje'i gter gyis bdag la bstsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bcings/ legs par bslab pa'i phyag rgya dang slob ma rang rigs sam/ bdag nyid mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis thugs rdo rje sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par gsal ba la phyag rgya rdo rje reg bya ma sngon mo gsal ba dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos gtad par bsam la/ gzungs ma 'di ni yid 'ong ba// sangs rgyas rnams kyis brten par gnang*// 'khor lo'i rim gyi sbyor ba yis// bde ba'i dam ba myang ba yis// thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya// 'gro ba gsum po 'di yis bdag /de bas 'di dang bral ba ni// khyod kyi nam yang mi bya'o// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med// blun po gang zhing 'di spong ba// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// ces brjod nas gtad pa'i phyag rgya des slob ma la/ bshang dang gci ba bza' ba dang*// sha dang khu khrag de bzhin te// bu khyod ci dgar spyod gyur tam// bud med brten du gus pa dang*/ bdag gi pad+mar 'o byed pa// bu khyod ci bzhed bden par smros// lan du slob mas/ khu khrag la sogs bza' ba dang*// bud med rnams la rtag gus pa'i// bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa// lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro// slar yang shes rab kyis/ e ma nga yi pad+ma ni// bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan// blun po gang zhig 'da' byed pa// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ste rtag tu gnas// badz+ra mok+ṣa hoḥ

zhes brjod nas/ rang dang rig ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang reg bya rdo rje ma yab yum du gyur/ gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ lte bar swā/ rkang par hā/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po dbus ma oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lha mo'i bha ga āḥlas pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po 'od zer lnga yis khyab pa/ oṃ sarba tā thā ga tā a nu rā ga swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ dus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa phan tshun rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro bas 'khyud pa dang 'o bya ba gzhibs pas yi ge hūm̐ glur len cing phaṭ kyis las na gnas par byas/ de yang snyoms par zhugs pas thig le rdo rje'i rtsa bar sleb tsa na rang bzhin sum cu rtsa gsum 'gag /bde ba'i ye shes de la stong pas rgyas btab ste bsgoms pas lam gyi ye shes snang ba/ thig le sked par sleb tsa na rang bzhin bzhi bcu 'gag /bde ba'i ye shes de la shin tu stong pas rgyas btab ste bsgoms pa lam gyi ye shes mched pa/ thig le bum par sleb tsa na rang bzhin bdun 'gag /bde ba'i ye shes de la stong pa chen pos rgyas btab ste bsgoms pa lam gyi ye shes snang ba nyer thob/ de tsam ni dbang gsum pa dang*/ gnyis shor gnyis mnyam gyi dus su dngos pos ngo bo nyid kyi rtog pa log pas bde ba'i ye shes thams cad stong pa 'od gsal ba de la dbang bzhi pa zhes bya'o// man ngag bzhin 'dzag med du'am/ phyir 'dzag na lces blangs par bya zhing*// zhes slob dpon gyis nang gi mngon byang bstan no// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bkrol/ de ltar bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ yid dang ye shes kyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /pho nya'i lam dang zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku dang ngo bo nyid mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa yin no//

de nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du/ dbang rnams rdzogs par thob pa'i sku drin gtang rag gi yon du/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ bla ma dang phyag rgya yon gyis mnyes par byas te tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu'o// dbang gi bya ba grub nas lha mnyes par bya phyir zhi ba dang rgyas pa'i sbyin bsreg 'bul bar bsrung zhing*/ mi 'grub na bsam gtan gyi sbyin sreg tsam bya ba'am/ dkyus su de tsam ma 'grub na gtor ma'i cho ga bya ste/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud rnams/ shar du go las ba glang gi sha/ lhor ku las khyi'i sha/ nub tu da las rta'i sha/ byang du ha las glang po che'i sha/ dbus su na las mi'i sha/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bi las dri chen/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du ma las klad pa/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ shar du bh+rūm̐/ lhor āṃ/ nub tu dz+rīṃ/ byang du khaṃ/ dbus su hūṃ/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse dgu pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung gi ba dan la phog /rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa bsregs/ dag pa zhu zhing khol ba'i rlangs pa oṃ dang hūm̐ la phog oṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa thod par lhung ba'i rlangs pa dang*/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur/ rdo rje zla ba oṃ dang bcas pa thod par lhung ste/ zhu nas dam tshig gi bdud rtsir 'dres pa/ hūm̐ gis sbyangs/ yi ge āḥs rtogs par byas/

oṃ gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bsnan pas sbyar ba kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐// zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du puṣ+pe nas shap+ta 'i bar dang*/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra hūm̐ nas par+she 'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas gtor ma 'bul sngags gtso bor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūṃ hūm̐/ bdun dang*/ yum la/ oṃ āḥspar+she badz+ra khaṃ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun/ rigs bzhir/ oṃ swā āḥha i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ yum bzhir/ laṃ māṃ paṃ tāṃ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

mchod lha bzhi por/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ byang sems brgyad la/ maiṃ thiṃl/ oṃ oṃ/ oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ saṃ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ khro bo bcu la/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum res phul/ de nas 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma a ka ro lan gsum gyis phul nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa la/ nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las dang mchog gi dngos grub stsol// zhes dngos grub zhu/ 'jig rten par/ dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya che kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la bsrung*// dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /de bzhin pha rol tshogs 'joms shing*// dgra rnams thams cad pham par mdzod// ces 'dod don gsol/ badz+ra muṃ gtor mgron ye shes pa rnams bdag nyid la thim/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ tshogs pa rol ba gong du ma song na 'dir bya ste/ las kyi rdo rjes/ bsod nams 'di yis sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes thob par gyur cig / ces brjod la bstab/ nang gi sbyin sreg bya/ lhag ma bsdus la/ hūm̐ bh+ruṃ phaiṃ

zhes kha phrus btab/ snod thod pa bcud ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por zhu bar gyur/ hūm̐/ ma rdo rje btsun mo khros pa'i gzugs// sogs kyi mthar lhag ma phyi rol 'gol sar spungs/ he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor du sogs kyis smon lam gdab bo// de nas rjes kyi cho ga ni mchod pa gsar du bsham pa'am/ rnying pa gso/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pad+yaṃ= añca ma naṃ= prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= ces chu bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ shap+ta= gan+dhe= ra sa= spar+she 'i bar gyis mchod/ sgrub mchod sogs kyi nyin phyi mar tshigs bcad spros te phul/ oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ ces nang mchod dang*/ oṃ mahā su kha pū dza āḥhūm̐/ zhes gsang mchod phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// sogs de nyid lngas bstod/ yig brgya brjod cing ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs bshags bzod gsol bya/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams rdul tshon skabs kyi nyin snga ma rnams la/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtses phyir// sogs dang*/ nyin phyi mar/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs kyis gshegs gsol bya/ ras bris yin na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya/ de nas/ bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha rtags pa la sogs pa rang gi gzugs phung sogs bzhi la/ spyan ma sogs khams la/ sems dpa' sems ma skye mched la/ khro bo rnams yan lag la bsdus te yab yum du gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las byung ba'i 'od kyis sems can thams cad la dbang bskur zhing reg pas thams cad dri ma dang bral nas snod gzhal yas khang bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gyur par

bsgom mo// nyer bsdu'i cho ga'o// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sangs rgyas kun gyi kun bdag nyid// rdo rje 'chang dbang thob gyur cig /'gro bas kyang ni de thob shog /byang chub phyir ni spyod gang dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gang yin pa// byang chub rdo rjes gang gsungs pa'i// spyod de gnyis ka'ang bdag spyod shog/ ces sogs kyis dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ dgong mo nyer bsdu byas pa'i nang par a ka ro yi ge gsum gyis rdul tshon 'phyags te klu du dor/ de nas g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis sngar btab pa'i phur pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra ki la ya ut+kī la ya/ sarba bigh+nan badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ hoḥ zhes brjod nas phyung*/ de'i skud pa snod kyi nang du gtsang mar bzhag phur pa'i dbal la bsang chu dang tsan dan gyis bskus/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swa twa ku ru swa twi swā hā/ de nas khro bo rnams la phyi nang glu gar gyis mchod/ gtor ma btang gshegs su gsol/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa ba byung gi lci bas byugs/ sems can rnams dang slob ma la phan pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o// de nas shis pa brjod pa ni/ srid dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs 'byung ba'i gter// gang las nam yang zad pa mi mnga' ba// rin chen dbang gi rgyal po la ma yi// byin rlabs mthu yis 'dod don kun 'grub shog /gzung dang 'dzin pas dbye bar mi nus pa'i// bden gnyis dbyer med rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /mtha' yas dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'khor los sgyur// ston pa rdo rje 'chang gi bkra shis shog /gsang chen bla med rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud// thabs shes gnyis med rdo rje gsum mnyam nyid// thun mong ma yin theg pa kun gyi rgyal// dpal ldan rgyud kyis deng 'dir bkra shis shog /rnam rtog tshogs kyis kun tu 'khrugs mi mnga'// gdul bya zhe sdang can la rab brtse ba// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das// dkyil 'khor dbang pos rtag tu bkra shis shog

/rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus// bdud rtsi'i stobs las rab tu rgyal gyur pa// khyab bdag rnam par snang mdzad bkra shis kyis// deng 'dir skye dgu rnams la bde legs shog /'dod dgu'i 'bras bu ma lus yongs rdzogs pa// yang dag mtha' yi yid bzhin rin chen 'chang*// rgyal ba rin chen tog gi bkra shis kyis// deng 'dir skye dgu rnams la bde legs shog /snang gsum ma lus pa las nges par grol// 'od gsal snang ba dpag med dang ldan pa// bcom ldan 'od dpag med pa'i bkra shis kyis// deng 'dir skye dgu rnams la bde legs shog /chos rnams kun tu rnam 'byed shes rab 'dzin// gdon mi za bar don rnams grub mdzad pa// mgon po don yod grub pa'i bkra shis kyis// deng 'dir skye dgu rnams la bde legs shog /rigs kyi yum dang lha mo rnam pa lnga// sems dpa' khro bo'i tshogs rnams gtso bo yi// ye shes mchog gi rnam rol bkra shis kyis// deng 'dir skye dgu rnams la bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i bka' sdod mthu stobs rmad byung ba// sgrib pa med pa'i spyan gyis rab gzigs nas// dam chos srung bar mdzad pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// deng 'dir skye dgu rnams la bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyin mo gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog/ ces sogs shis pa rgya cher brjod pas dge legs kyi dpal yon rnam pa kun tu spel bar bya'o// de ltar gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags pa'i zhal lung zhes bya ba/ slob dpon yab sras kyi lung ji lta ba rdo rje 'chang mar pa'i phyag bzhes ma 'chugs par bkod pa pad+ma dkar pos rgyal byed tshal du sbyar ba 'dis kyang 'gro ba thams cad bde ba chen po'i sa la snyeg pa la skom pa chu mthong nas rgyug pa ltar gyur cig/ mos pa'i rjes song dbang gi cho ga'i mthar// kun shes rgyal nyid de bas dbyangs can ma// dgyes pa'i tshig gter mgul bum la chags pa'i// klu byang lugs rjes 'khrul med zhugs pa 'di// spro 'dod lhad kyis ngal ba ma mchis la// dgos don ma tshang med par 'byung ba na// tshe gcig sangs rgyas sa la chas rnams la// mthun rkyen sbyor ba'i dpag bsam dbang po nyid// de ltar dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs dang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga

kun mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+ma dkar po'i gsung gsang las byung ba nyid/ dbang bskur dang sgrub mchod sogs 'jug pa bde bar khrigs su sdeb par byos shig ces mchog gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'gyur med theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rin po che dang*/ rje btsun chos kyi dbang phyug rin po che sogs dpal 'brug pa'i bstan pa 'dzin dbang mchog rnams kyis gsung bskul phebs par brten/ mkhas dbang bud+dha'i zhabs dang*/ 'jam mgon yon tan rgya mtsho sogs kyi gsung tshad mar gyur pa dag la sgo bstun te/ ngag dbang mthu stobs tshul khrims bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos lhag bsam dag pas bkod pa 'dir tshul bzhin ma rtogs pa'i nyes tshogs mtha' dag bla ma lhag pa'i lha dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar snying nas 'chags shing*/ dge bas 'gro kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang dam pa myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig// /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
